detail.body:
## Overview

Hand/Agent-written gfx950 kernels for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode at TP4, covering the decode steps of 17-256 rows
that the mono decode layer (`--monokernel`) leaves to vLLM's ops. All code is in
`vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/`, next to the mono decode layer.

## Claims

- 1.15-1.54× lower median TPOT than `--monokernel` alone at 8k and 200k context, c32-128 (MI355X × 4, TP4).
- 1.32× with DSpark (5 drafts) at 8k c16. Parity at c64, whose 384-row steps are past this PR's 256.
- No accuracy change: gsm8k, and needle retrieval up to 1M context, match.
- On automatically with `--monokernel` on gfx950 at TP4. No new flags or env vars; every other configuration is
  unchanged.

## Validation

`vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 --tensor-parallel-size 4 --monokernel --moe-backend aiter
--block-size 128 --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --attention-config
'{"indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}' --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}'
--language-model-only --max-num-seqs 256 --enable-prefix-caching` with `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_TRITON_SPARSE_MLA=1 VLLM_ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4
VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1`, Model Runner V2, MI355X × 4. Baseline: the same command on the same node without
this change.

Median TPOT (ms) per run, median and (min-max) of 3 runs per point, gsm8k-text prompts after a shared cached
prefix, 1024 output tokens, greedy:

| context | concurrency | `--monokernel` | this PR | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8k | 32 | 8.19 (8.18-8.41) | 7.16 (7.15-7.17) | 1.15× |
| 8k | 64 | 12.33 (12.31-13.48) | 8.83 (8.78-8.93) | 1.40× |
| 8k | 128 | 15.72 (15.66-15.92) | 11.58 (11.56-11.69) | 1.36× |
| 200k | 32 | 8.21 (8.06-8.37) | 7.03 (6.92-7.07) | 1.17× |
| 200k | 64 | 11.96 (11.63-12.14) | 7.77 (7.71-8.21) | 1.54× |
| 200k | 128 | 14.63 (14.39-15.66) | 10.79 (9.44-11.33) | 1.36× |
| 8k, DSpark | 16 | 4.07 (4.06-4.09) | 3.08 (3.06-3.31) | 1.32× |
| 8k, DSpark | 64 | 6.41 (6.38-6.75) | 6.47 (6.36-6.48) | 0.99× |

DSpark acceptance is unchanged (0.54 / 0.55).

| check | result |
|---|---|
| gsm8k 8-shot (1319), c16 / c64 / c128 | 92.3 / 91.1 / 90.1 % and 90.6 / 90.8 / 89.8 % in two runs (the same kernels as an out-of-tree plugin on this vLLM: 91.7 / 91.3 / 90.3 %) |
| `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error`, gsm8k c64 / c128 and 256 greedy requests at c256 | no sync errors, no tracebacks |
| needles at `--max-model-len 1048576`: one shared 1M haystack (c64) / mixed 8k-1M rows / one 1M row | 63 / 64 (a near tie that `--monokernel` alone also misses), 64 / 64, 16 / 16 |
| 1M-context decode, c64 and c256 | runs, no errors |
| chaos traffic with a 12000-block KV pool (10 min, aborts, greedy canaries) | 7,249 requests, 30 / 30 canaries, no non-finite logprobs |
| new `tests/models/test_dsv41_asm_layers.py` (TP4, 32-row steps, `--monokernel` on vs off, every layer's outputs) | passes (twice, ~105 s): max 8.4% layer output / 0.8% residual difference outside near-tie routing flips, 20% of tokens flip (bounds 12% / 2% / 25%) |
| `tests/models/test_dsv41_mono_numerics.py`, `test_dsv41_mono_layers.py` (this directory's MI355 job, 4 GPUs) | numerics 3 passed, 2 skipped (gfx942, 8 GPUs); layers 2 passed (TP2 / TP4 at 8 rows), 3 skipped (gfx942, 8 GPUs) |

## Details

What runs where, for decode steps of 17-256 rows (steps up to 16 rows stay on the mono decode layer, whose limit
drops from 48 to 16 when this is on, because it is faster there):

- K1, the attention half: seam, front (wqkv, norms, SWA insert, wq_b), sparse attention, and back (wo_a, wo_b) with
  all-reduce #1 folded into wo_b's launch (MXFP8 wire). On the index layers it also covers the indexer's q side,
  the compressor tail, and the indexer's logits + top-512 in one launch, up to 32 · 16384 compressed positions.
  Wider rows use vLLM's indexer.
- K2, the FFN half: seam, router, shared expert, routed MoE (MXFP4 experts), combine with all-reduce #2 folded in.
- Engram: wkv moves to the prefetch stream (resharded once, so the kv all-gather goes away); the next attention
  seam applies gate · value.
- Prefill, mixed steps' attention and steps above 256 rows stay on vLLM's path.

Code: `asm/decode.py` holds `AsmDecodeLayer`, created next to `MonoDecodeLayer`. `model.py` calls into it at the
decoder layer's seams, attention and FFN. `rocm.py` routes the attention's eager break (`_sparse_indexer_and_attn`)
through it. `asm/engram.py` subclasses `Engram`, and `mono_decode.py` takes its row limit from it.
`asm/kernels/` are Python generators of AMDGPU assembly. They are assembled with the image's LLVM (clang, ld.lld)
on each worker's first forward, cached under `$VLLM_CACHE_ROOT/dsv41_asm`, and launched through HIP's module API
(ctypes). The generators carry `# ruff: noqa: E501` and `# mypy: ignore-errors`, as the Muse Spark monokernel's
do. `pyproject.toml`: typos allows `offen`, the buffer instructions' offset-enable modifier.

It turns on with `--monokernel` on gfx950 at TP4, with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash's shapes and clang / ld.lld found.
It stays off, with a log line, for LoRA, KV transfer, pipeline or decode context parallelism, and per layer for
another KV cache dtype or MoE routing. Expert or data parallelism is already refused by `--monokernel`.

Limitations and tradeoffs:
- TP4 only: the folded all-reduces are written for 4 ranks. At most 256 rows per decode step.
- About 16k lines, nearly all generated-assembly sources. They are self-contained (no dependency changes), and no
  shared or core code path changes.
- The weights are repacked on the first forward, so in-place weight reloads aren't picked up.
- Numerics are not bitwise vLLM's (MXFP8 all-reduce wire, a different rounding order). They were checked against
  fp64 references on captured layers during development and end to end as above.
- CI: `tests/models/test_dsv41_asm_layers.py` joins the MI355 4-GPU DSv4.1 mono decode step (`test-amd.yaml`,
  `test_areas/models_basic.yaml`). It reuses `test_dsv41_mono_layers.py`'s five-layer random-weight model: TP4,
  32-row decode steps, `--monokernel` on (the asm path; a probe checks K1 / K2 / Engram took the steps on every
  rank) against off, each layer's outputs per token. Its bounds are wider than the mono test's because the
  all-reduces carry MXFP8 here. Skips off gfx950, under 4 GPUs, or without clang / ld.lld.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.

</details>

@@ -0,0 +1,158 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The DeepSeek-V4.1 asm decode layers (``vllm/models/deepseek_v41/amd/asm``)
+through the real model: the five-layer DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash of
+``test_dsv41_mono_layers.py`` at TP4 on gfx950, served with ``--monokernel`` on
+and off on the same random weights, with decode steps of 32 rows. Those steps
+are past the mono decode layer's 16, so with ``--monokernel`` on they run on the
+asm kernels: K2 on every layer, K1 on the index and consumer layers (1-4), and
+the Engram side chain (layer 2's wkv on the prefetch stream). Every decoder
+layer's outputs at every decode step must match vLLM's path."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from .test_dsv41_mono_layers import (
+    LOAD_FORMAT,
+    MODEL,
+    STEPS,
+    TRUNCATED,
+    MonoProbe,
+    _rel,
+)
+
+TP, ROWS = 4, 32
+K1_LAYERS, K2_LAYERS = (1, 2, 3, 4), (0, 1, 2, 3, 4)
+
+
+class AsmProbe(MonoProbe):
+    def asm_layers(self) -> dict:
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm import decode, engram
+
+        layers = {
+            i: None
+            if m.asm is None
+            else [m.asm.attn_fn is not None, m.asm.ffn_fn is not None]
+            for i, m in self._decoder_layers().items()
+        }
+        return {
+            "layers": layers,
+            "k1": sorted(decode._k1["seen"]),
+            "k2": sorted(decode._k2["seen"]),
+            "engram": sorted(engram._eg["seen"]),
+        }
+
+
+def _decode(vllm_runner, monkeypatch, mono: bool, prompts, path: str):
+    from vllm import SamplingParams
+    from vllm.inputs import TokensPrompt
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE", "1")
+    with vllm_runner(
+        MODEL,
+        tensor_parallel_size=TP,
+        load_format=LOAD_FORMAT,
+        hf_overrides=TRUNCATED,
+        worker_extension_cls=f"{__name__}.AsmProbe",
+        moe_backend="aiter",
+        monokernel=mono,
+        language_model_only=True,
+        tokenizer_mode="deepseek_v41",
+        attention_config={"indexer_kv_dtype": "mxfp4", "indexer_sparse_logits": True},
+        engram_config={"cpu_offload": True},
+        block_size=128,
+        enforce_eager=True,
+        max_model_len=4096,
+        max_num_seqs=len(prompts),
+        # All prompts prefill in one step, so that every decode step has all
+        # the rows.
+        max_num_batched_tokens=max(16384, sum(len(p) for p in prompts)),
+        enable_prefix_caching=False,
+        gpu_memory_utilization=0.5,
+    ) as runner:
+        runner.llm.collective_rpc("capture_steps", args=([len(p) for p in prompts],))
+        params = SamplingParams(temperature=0.0, max_tokens=STEPS + 1)
+        outs = runner.llm.generate(
+            [TokensPrompt(prompt_token_ids=p) for p in prompts], params
+        )
+        runner.llm.collective_rpc("save_capture", args=(path,))
+        probe = runner.llm.collective_rpc("asm_layers")
+    return [o.outputs[0] for o in outs], probe
+
+
+def test_asm_decode_matches_the_model(vllm_runner, monkeypatch, tmp_path):
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        pytest.skip("the asm decode kernels target gfx950")
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    if not on_gfx950():
+        pytest.skip("the asm decode kernels target gfx950")
+    if torch.accelerator.device_count() < TP:
+        pytest.skip(f"needs {TP} GPUs")
+    pytest.importorskip("flydsl")
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels.build import toolchain_missing
+
+    if missing := toolchain_missing():
+        pytest.skip(f"needs {missing} to build the kernels")
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    # Contexts past both ratios' 512 compressed entries, and prompt lengths
+    # more than STEPS apart (the captures key a token by length and position).
+    lens: list[int] = []
+    for n in torch.randperm(1700, generator=g).add(300).tolist():
+        if all(abs(n - m) > STEPS for m in lens):
+            lens.append(n)
+        if len(lens) == ROWS:
+            break
+    prompts = [torch.randint(1000, 60000, (n,), generator=g).tolist() for n in lens]
+
+    on, probe_on = _decode(vllm_runner, monkeypatch, True, prompts, f"{tmp_path}/on")
+    off, probe_off = _decode(
+        vllm_runner, monkeypatch, False, prompts, f"{tmp_path}/off"
+    )
+
+    # the asm kernels took the 32-row steps on every rank
+    for rank in probe_on:
+        assert rank["layers"] == {
+            i: [i in K1_LAYERS, i in K2_LAYERS] for i in K2_LAYERS
+        }, rank
+        for part in ("k1", "k2", "engram"):
+            assert ROWS in rank[part], rank
+    assert all(set(r["layers"].values()) == {None} for r in probe_off)
+
+    same: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
+    for prompt, a, b in zip(prompts, on, off):
+        for step in range(STEPS):
+            if a.token_ids[: step + 1] != b.token_ids[: step + 1]:
+                break
+            same.add((len(prompt), len(prompt) + step))
+
+    # each layer's outputs for those tokens, asm against vLLM's path, token by
+    # token. The all-reduces carry MXFP8 here (bf16 on vLLM's path), which
+    # puts every layer's output 7% off vLLM's in the median and 8.4% at most:
+    # 12%. The residual stream follows at under 1% (0.8% seen): 2%. A token
+    # whose top-6 routing is a near tie on vLLM's path (6th / 7th scores within
+    # 5e-3 at layer 0, 1e-2 past it, as in test_dsv41_mono_layers.py) may pick
+    # another expert and land far off (48-77% seen); the later layers are
+    # exempt for it, and at most a quarter of the tokens may flip (20% seen).
+    for rank in range(TP):
+        got, _ = torch.load(f"{tmp_path}/on.rank{rank}")
+        want, gaps = torch.load(f"{tmp_path}/off.rank{rank}")
+        keys = sorted(same & {k[1:] for k in got} & {k[1:] for k in want})
+        assert len(keys) >= len(prompts), keys
+        flipped: set = set()
+        for i in K2_LAYERS:
+            for k in keys:
+                if k in flipped:
+                    continue
+                (x, res), (x_ref, res_ref) = got[(i, *k)], want[(i, *k)]
+                err = _rel(res, res_ref)
+                assert err < 0.02, (rank, i, k, "residual", err)
+                err = _rel(x, x_ref)
+                if err >= 0.12:
+                    tie = 5e-3 if i == 0 else 1e-2
+                    assert gaps[(i, *k)] < tie, (rank, i, k, "x", err)
+                    flipped.add(k)
+        assert len(flipped) <= len(keys) // 4, (rank, sorted(flipped))

@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Hand-written gfx950 (MI355X) decode kernels for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at TP4:
+the decoder layers' decode steps of 17-256 rows (``decode.AsmDecodeLayer``)
+next to the mono decode layer, which keeps those of up to 16. The kernels are
+generated as assembly at first use, built with LLVM (clang, ld.lld) into code
+objects cached under $VLLM_CACHE_ROOT/dsv41_asm and launched through HIP."""

@@ -0,0 +1,366 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The fp8-wire all-reduce (kernels/ar2.py ``source_fp8``) across the 4 TP
+processes: landing buffers and flags are hipMalloc'd per rank and shared with
+the peers through IPC handles (exchanged over a CPU process group), as vLLM's
+custom all-reduce does. ``out`` is written only by its own rank, so it is a
+plain torch tensor (graph-pool friendly).
+
+    # once per process, outside graph capture
+    ar = FP8AllReduce(rank, cpu_group)
+    # part [M, 5120] bf16, M ≤ 256 → out [M, 5120] bf16
+    out = ar(part)
+
+Every rank must make the same calls in the same order (the per-CTA sequence
+counters live in the flags buffer and must agree). A rank that stops calling
+leaves its peers spinning until ar2.POLLS runs out; ``errors()`` counts those
+timeouts.
+"""
+
+import ctypes
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels import ar2
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels.kmod import Kernel
+
+H = ar2.H
+
+
+class _IpcHandle(ctypes.Structure):
+    _fields_ = [
+        ("reserved", ctypes.c_ubyte * 64)
+    ]  # not c_char: its field reads stop at the first NUL
+
+
+def _hip():
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels.build import hip
+
+    h = hip()
+    h.hipMalloc.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_size_t]
+    h.hipMemset.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_size_t]
+    h.hipIpcGetMemHandle.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(_IpcHandle), ctypes.c_void_p]
+    h.hipIpcOpenMemHandle.argtypes = [
+        ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p),
+        _IpcHandle,
+        ctypes.c_uint,
+    ]
+    return h
+
+
+def flag_state(ptr: int, nb: int, g: int) -> tuple[list, list]:
+    """The last 2g dwords of a flags buffer (ar2 / eg_ag layout: ... ctr [g], err [g])
+    as (ctr, err) lists. Syncs."""
+    f = torch.empty(nb // 4, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    h = _hip()
+    h.hipMemcpy.argtypes = [
+        ctypes.c_void_p,
+        ctypes.c_void_p,
+        ctypes.c_size_t,
+        ctypes.c_int,
+    ]
+    h.hipMemcpy(ctypes.c_void_p(f.data_ptr()), ctypes.c_void_p(ptr), nb, 3)
+    t = f[-2 * g :].tolist()
+    return t[:g], t[g:]
+
+
+def ipc_alloc(sizes: dict, rank: int, cpu_group, world: int = 4) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
+    """hipMalloc'd, zeroed buffers {name: bytes} on every rank, shared through
+    IPC handles (collective over cpu_group) → (mine {name: ptr}, all {name:
+    [ptr of rank d's buffer in this process, d < world]})."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels.build import _check
+
+    h = _hip()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    mine, handles = {}, {}
+    # plain hipMalloc (coarse-grained, cached): peers write these buffers and we read
+    # them; an uncached allocation (as vLLM's custom all-reduce uses for its signals)
+    # costs ~20 µs per decode step
+    for n, sz in sizes.items():
+        p = ctypes.c_void_p()
+        _check(h.hipMalloc(ctypes.byref(p), sz), f"hipMalloc {n}")
+        _check(h.hipMemset(p, 0, sz), f"hipMemset {n}")
+        hd = _IpcHandle()
+        _check(h.hipIpcGetMemHandle(ctypes.byref(hd), p), f"hipIpcGetMemHandle {n}")
+        mine[n], handles[n] = p.value, ctypes.string_at(ctypes.addressof(hd), 64)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    gathered: list = [None] * world
+    torch.distributed.all_gather_object(gathered, handles, group=cpu_group)
+    every: dict[int, list] = {n: [] for n in sizes}
+    for n in sizes:
+        for d in range(world):
+            if d == rank:
+                every[n].append(mine[n])
+                continue
+            hd = _IpcHandle()
+            ctypes.memmove(ctypes.addressof(hd), gathered[d][n], 64)
+            p = ctypes.c_void_p()
+            _check(
+                h.hipIpcOpenMemHandle(ctypes.byref(p), hd, 1),
+                f"hipIpcOpenMemHandle {n} of rank {d}",
+            )
+            every[n].append(p.value)
+    _ipc_check(h, mine, every, rank, cpu_group, world)
+    return mine, every
+
+
+_ipc_seq = [0]
+
+
+def _ipc_check(h, mine: dict, every: dict, rank: int, cpu_group, world: int) -> None:
+    """Every rank writes a signature (magic, rank, allocation #, buffer #) at
+    the start of each of its new buffers; every rank reads its peers' through
+    the opened IPC pointers. A mismatch means a mapping lands in some other
+    allocation (peer flag writes that never arrived).
+    Prints the pointers' page offsets too (suballocation). Buffers are re-zeroed."""
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+
+    h.hipMemcpy.argtypes = [
+        ctypes.c_void_p,
+        ctypes.c_void_p,
+        ctypes.c_size_t,
+        ctypes.c_int,
+    ]
+    _ipc_seq[0] += 1
+    names = list(mine)
+    sig = lambda r, i: (0x5A5A0000 | i, r, _ipc_seq[0], 0x1234)
+    for i, n in enumerate(names):
+        buf = (ctypes.c_int32 * 4)(*sig(rank, i))
+        h.hipMemcpy(ctypes.c_void_p(mine[n]), ctypes.cast(buf, ctypes.c_void_p), 16, 1)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    dist.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+    bad = []
+    for i, n in enumerate(names):
+        for d in range(world):
+            if d == rank:
+                continue
+            buf = (ctypes.c_int32 * 4)()
+            h.hipMemcpy(
+                ctypes.cast(buf, ctypes.c_void_p), ctypes.c_void_p(every[n][d]), 16, 2
+            )
+            got = tuple(v & 0xFFFFFFFF for v in buf)
+            want = tuple(v & 0xFFFFFFFF for v in sig(d, i))
+            if got != want:

+"""An index source layer's compressor tail in one launch
+(Triton: launch-bound glue, ~nothing to win from asm).
+
+vLLM runs four kernels after the compressor GEMM: on the aux stream
+``_fused_save_compress_norm`` (ring save, ratio-2 softmax pool, RMSNorm →
+bf16 latent) and ``_rope_quant_insert`` (the compressed-cache record); after
+the streams join, on the critical path, the indexer's ``wk`` (hipBLASLt) and
+aiter's ``_k_norm_rope_mxfp4_cache``. ``comp_tail`` is vLLM's first kernel
+(same grid, programs and ring handling; ROCm's unjoined row loads, no PCP)
+whose latent epilogue also does the other three for that token, so the whole
+chain stays on the aux stream:
+
+1. latent = bf16(RMSNorm(pooled)) (``_store_latent``), also kept in ``lat``
+   (the K GEMV reads it back in chunks: one global round trip, same program);
+2. the compressed insert, fp8_ds_mla 584 B record (``_rope_quant_insert_kernel``
+   with gfx950's NaN sanitising) at the compressed cache's slot;
+3. k = bf16(latent · wkᵀ) (fp32, 4 chunks of 128: not hipBLASLt's order, so
+   k can be 1 bf16 ulp off), k_norm → bf16, GPT-J RoPE on the last 64 dims at
+   the group start → bf16, MXFP4 (aiter's ceil scales and pack instruction)
+   in aiter's page shuffle at the indexer K cache's slot
+   (``_k_norm_rope_mxfp4_cache_kernel``).
+
+Slot mappings keep vLLM's meaning (−1 skips); records are written only at
+group ends, as vLLM's kernels do.
+
+rstd (the index layers' v3 front, K1 v3): the GEMM ran on y' = bf16(x1 ·
+attn_norm.w) without the norm's rstd; each token's kv_score row is scaled by
+rstd[t] = rsq(Σx1² / 5120 + eps) as it is loaded, from the attention seam's
+partials (``ffn_seam.source_v2``: [token][160 slices][32] f32, Σx1² at 25).
+The ring keeps the scaled rows.
+"""
+
+import torch
+from aiter.ops.triton._triton_kernels.quant.quant import _mxfp4_quant_op
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+D, KD = 512, 128  # latent dim, indexer head dim
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _finish(
+    pooled,
+    t,
+    positions,
+    norm_w,
+    eps,
+    lat,
+    ccache,
+    cslots,
+    ccs,
+    ccs_stride,
+    cpage_stride,
+    wk,
+    knorm_w,
+    keps,
+    kcs,
+    kcs_stride,
+    kcache,
+    kslots,
+    kpage_stride,
+    kpage,
+    CBLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    RATIO: tl.constexpr,
+    NPT: tl.constexpr,
+    DPT: tl.constexpr,
+    SLANES: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    d = tl.arange(0, 512)
+    position = tl.load(positions + t)
+    gpos = position // RATIO * RATIO
+    # 1. latent (_store_latent)
+    w = tl.load(norm_w + d).to(tl.float32)
+    variance = tl.sum(pooled * pooled, 0) / 512
+    latb = (pooled * tl.rsqrt(variance + eps) * w).to(tl.bfloat16)
+    tl.store(lat + t.to(tl.int64) * 512 + d, latb)
+    normed = latb.to(tl.float32)
+
+    # 2. compressed insert (_rope_quant_insert_kernel, 584 B records,
+    # SANITIZE_CACHE_NANS)
+    slot = tl.load(cslots + t)
+    if slot >= 0:
+        page = ccache + (slot // CBLOCK).to(tl.int64) * cpage_stride
+        values = page + (slot % CBLOCK) * 576
+        scales = page + CBLOCK * 576 + (slot % CBLOCK) * 8
+        quant = tl.reshape(normed, (8, 64))
+        amax = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(quant), 1), 1e-4)
+        exponent = tl.ceil(tl.log2(amax * (1.0 / 448.0)))
+        scaled = quant * tl.reshape(tl.exp2(-exponent), (8, 1))
+        fp8 = tl.clamp(scaled, -448.0, 448.0).to(tl.float8e4nv)
+        packed = tl.reshape(fp8.to(tl.uint8, bitcast=True), (512,))
+        tl.store(values + d, packed, d < 448)
+        s8 = tl.arange(0, 8)
+        encoded = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(exponent + 127.0, 0.0), 254.0)
+        tl.store(scales + s8, encoded.to(tl.uint8), s8 < 7)
+        tl.store(scales + 7, tl.full((), 0, tl.uint8))
+        even, odd = tl.split(tl.reshape(normed, (256, 2)))
+        pair = tl.arange(0, 256) - 224
+        cs = ccs + gpos * ccs_stride
+        c = tl.load(cs + tl.maximum(pair, 0), pair >= 0, other=1.0).to(tl.float32)
+        s = tl.load(cs + 32 + tl.maximum(pair, 0), pair >= 0, other=0.0).to(tl.float32)
+        rotated = tl.interleave(even * c - odd * s, odd * c + even * s)
+        rotated = tl.where(rotated == rotated, rotated, 0.0)
+        rope_dst = (values + 448).to(tl.pointer_type(tl.bfloat16))
+        tl.store(rope_dst + d - 448, rotated.to(tl.bfloat16), d >= 448)
+
+    # 3. indexer K store
+    kslot = tl.load(kslots + t)
+    if kslot >= 0:
+        tl.debug_barrier()  # every lane's latent store is in before the chunk reads
+        n = tl.arange(0, 128)
+        acc = tl.zeros((128,), tl.float32)
+        for c4 in tl.static_range(4):
+            xc = tl.load(lat + t.to(tl.int64) * 512 + c4 * 128 + n).to(tl.float32)
+            wc = tl.load(wk + n[:, None] * 512 + c4 * 128 + n[None, :]).to(tl.float32)
+            acc += tl.sum(wc * xc[None, :], 1)
+        k = acc.to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+        kw = tl.load(knorm_w + n).to(tl.float32)
+        kvar = tl.sum(k * k, axis=0) / 128
+        k = (k * tl.rsqrt(kvar + keps) * kw).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+        ke, ko = tl.split(tl.reshape(k, (64, 2)))
+        rp = tl.arange(0, 64) - 32
+        is_rope = rp >= 0
+        cidx = tl.maximum(rp, 0)
+        kb = kcs + gpos * kcs_stride
+        cos = tl.load(kb + cidx, mask=is_rope, other=1.0)
+        sin = tl.load(kb + 32 + cidx, mask=is_rope, other=0.0)
+        ne = (ke * cos - ko * sin).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+        no = (ko * cos + ke * sin).to(tl.bfloat16).to(tl.float32)
+        k_rot = tl.reshape(tl.join(ne, no), (1, 128))
+        kq, e8 = _mxfp4_quant_op(k_rot, 128, 1, 32, SCALING_MODE=1, USE_ASM=True)
+        kq = tl.reshape(kq, (64,))
+        e8 = tl.reshape(e8, (4,))
+        pg = kcache + (kslot // kpage).to(tl.int64) * kpage_stride
+        p = kslot % kpage
+        byte = tl.arange(0, 64)
+        si = tl.arange(0, 4)
+        S_HI: tl.constexpr = 4 // SLANES
+        grp = p // NPT
+        lane = p % NPT
+        voff = grp * (NPT * 64) + byte // DPT * (NPT * DPT) + lane * DPT + byte % DPT
+        soff = grp * (NPT * 4) + si % SLANES * (NPT * S_HI) + lane * S_HI + si // SLANES
+        tl.store(pg + voff, kq)
+        tl.store(pg + kpage * 64 + soff, e8)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _ld(p, off, SPLIT: tl.constexpr, SPLIT_STRIDE: tl.constexpr):
+    """raw[off], or the sum of comp_gemm's SPLIT partial planes in plane order."""
+    v = tl.load(p + off)
+    for s in tl.static_range(1, SPLIT):
+        v += tl.load(p + s * SPLIT_STRIDE + off)
+    return v

+@triton.jit
+def _rstd(rs_part, t, rs_eps, RSTD: tl.constexpr):

+def comp_tail(
+    kv_score,
+    positions,
+    ratio,
+    state_cache,
+    state_slots,
+    query_start_loc,
+    req_ids,
+    norm_w,
+    eps,
+    lat,
+    ccache,
+    cslots,
+    ccs,
+    wk,
+    knorm_w,
+    keps,
+    kcs,
+    kcache,
+    kslots,

+    rs_eps: float = 0.0,

+):
+    """kv_score fp32 [T, 512·ratio] → ring save (ratio 2), compressed insert
+    (ccache uint8 [blocks, CBLOCK, 584] pages, slots cslots, cos/sin ccs) and
+    the indexer K store (kcache uint8 pages of kpage entries × 68 B, slots

+    split > 1: kv_score is comp_gemm's partials [split, ≥ T, 512·ratio] (summed
+    here in plane order; the ring gets the sums). rs_part (the attention seam's
+    partials [≥ T, 160, 32] f32) + rs_eps (attn_norm's): rows × rstd[t]."""

+        ratio in (1, 2)

+        kv_score,
+        positions,
+        state_cache,
+        state_slots,
+        query_start_loc,
+        req_ids,
+        norm_w,
+        eps,
+        lat,
+        ccache,
+        cslots,
+        ccs,
+        ccs.stride(0),
+        cpages.stride(0),
+        wk,
+        knorm_w,
+        keps,
+        kcs,
+        kcs.stride(0),
+        kcache,
+        kslots,
+        kpages.stride(0),
+        kpage,
+        num_tokens,

+        float(rs_eps),
+        RAW_STRIDE=kv_score.stride(0),
+        STATE_STRIDE=st[0],
+        STATE_ROW_STRIDE=st[1],
+        STATE_BLOCK=st[2],

+        CBLOCK=ccache.shape[1],

+        DPT=dpt,
+        SLANES=sl,
+        SPLIT=split,
+        SPLIT_STRIDE=sstride,
+        RSTD=rs_part is not None,
+        num_warps=num_warps,

+@triton.jit
+def _comp_gemm_kernel(
+    x,
+    w,
+    part,
+    M,
+    stride_x,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    SPLIT: tl.constexpr,
+    PSTRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    BM: tl.constexpr,
+    BN: tl.constexpr,
+    BK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """part[s] [M, N] fp32 = x[:, K slice s] · w[:, K slice s]ᵀ (bf16)."""
+    pid = tl.program_id(0)
+    NT: tl.constexpr = N // BN
+    mt = tl.cdiv(M, BM)
+    pn = pid % NT
+    pm = (pid // NT) % mt
+    s = pid // NT // mt
+    KS: tl.constexpr = K // SPLIT
+    om = pm * BM + tl.arange(0, BM)
+    on = pn * BN + tl.arange(0, BN)
+    ok = tl.arange(0, BK)
+    mm = om[:, None] < M
+    acc = tl.zeros((BM, BN), tl.float32)
+    for k in range(s * KS, s * KS + KS, BK):
+        a = tl.load(
+            x + om[:, None].to(tl.int64) * stride_x + k + ok[None, :],
+            mask=mm,
+            other=0.0,
+        )
+        b = tl.load(w + on[:, None] * K + k + ok[None, :])
+        acc = tl.dot(a, tl.trans(b), acc)
+    tl.store(part + s * PSTRIDE + om[:, None] * N + on[None, :], acc, mask=mm)
+
+
+def gemm_cfg(m: int, n: int = 1024) -> dict:
+    """comp_gemm's tiles by M and N (tuned with cold weights; µs vs hipBLASLt): N 1024:
+    5.4 / 6.3 / 8.8 vs 9.6 / 12.1 / 14.4 at M 64 / 128 / 256; N 512: 3.8 / 4.3 / 5.3 vs
+    8.0 / 8.3 / 10.9."""
+    if n == 512:
+        c = (
+            (64, 32, 64, 16)
+            if m <= 64
+            else (64, 64, 64, 16)
+            if m <= 128
+            else (64, 64, 128, 8)
+        )
+    else:
+        c = (
+            (64, 32, 128, 8)
+            if m <= 64
+            else (64, 64, 128, 8)
+            if m <= 128
+            else (64, 64, 128, 4)
+        )
+    return dict(BM=c[0], BN=c[1], BK=c[2], split=c[3], num_warps=4, num_stages=3)
+
+
+def comp_gemm(x, w, part, cfg=None):
+    """X bf16 [M, K] (unit column stride), w bf16 [N, K] → part fp32
+    [split, ≥ M, N] (``comp_tail(.., split=)``'s kv_score); returns it."""
+    M, K = x.shape
+    N = w.shape[0]
+    cfg = cfg or gemm_cfg(M, N)
+    sp, bm, bn, bk = cfg["split"], cfg["BM"], cfg["BN"], cfg["BK"]
+    assert x.stride(1) == 1 and w.is_contiguous() and K % (sp * bk) == 0 and N % bn == 0
+    assert (
+        part.dim() == 3
+        and part.shape[0] >= sp
+        and part.shape[1] >= M
+        and part.shape[2] == N
+        and part.is_contiguous()
+    )
+    _comp_gemm_kernel[(sp * triton.cdiv(M, bm) * (N // bn),)](
+        x,
+        w,
+        part,
+        M,
+        x.stride(0),
+        N=N,
+        K=K,
+        SPLIT=sp,
+        PSTRIDE=part.stride(0),
+        BM=bm,
+        BN=bn,
+        BK=bk,
+        num_warps=cfg["num_warps"],
+        num_stages=cfg.get("num_stages", 2),
+    )
+    return part[:sp]

+"""DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode steps of 17-256 rows on hand-written gfx950
+kernels (MI355X, TP4), next to the mono decode layer (``--monokernel``), which
+keeps the steps of up to 16 rows.
+
+Per decoder layer:
+
+- K1, the attention half: our seam (mHC pre-mix + norm), front (wqkv, norms,
+  SWA insert, wq_b), sparse attention, back (wo_a, wo_b) with all-reduce #1 in
+  the same launch (fp8 wire); on the index layers also the indexer's q side,
+  the compressor tail and the indexer top-k (logits + top-512 in one launch,
+  wide rows and the candidate source / consumers up to 32 · 16384 compressed
+  positions);
+- K2, the FFN half: seam, router, shared expert, routed MoE (MXFP4 experts),
+  combine with all-reduce #2 (fp8 wire);
+- the Engram layers' wkv on the prefetch stream, their gate · value applied by
+  the next attention seam (``engram.py``).
+
+Anything else (prefill, mixed steps' attention, other shapes) stays on vLLM's
+path. The layer's forward calls in at its seams (``seam``), attention
+(``attn``) and FFN (``ffn``), the attention's eager break at
+``sparse_indexer_and_attn``; each returns None where vLLM's path runs.

+def enabled(vllm_config) -> bool:

+    ld.lld) to build the kernels. Decided once, when the first decoder layer is

+    if "on" not in _cfg:

+        if not vllm_config.kernel_config.monokernel:

+        else:

+class AsmDecodeLayer:
+    """One decoder layer's asm decode path. Built with the layer; its kernels,
+    weights and collectives are set up on the layer's first forward (vLLM's
+    eager profile run, weights loaded)."""
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def create(layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer", vllm_config) -> "AsmDecodeLayer | None":
+        return AsmDecodeLayer(layer) if enabled(vllm_config) else None
+
+    def __init__(self, layer: "DeepseekV4DecoderLayer"):
+        self.layer = layer
+        self.installed = False
+        # seam handlers, tried in order: K2's (the FFN seam), then K1's or the
+        # Engram seam's (the attention seam)
+        self.seams: list[Callable] = []
+        self.attn_fn: Callable | None = None
+        self.ffn_fn: Callable | None = None
+        self.mqa_fn: Callable | None = None
+        self.idx_topk_fn: Callable | None = None
+        self.tk_hook: Callable | None = None
+        self.flush_engram = False

+    def install(self) -> None:
+        if self.installed:
+            return
+        self.installed = True
+        layer = self.layer
+        lo, hi = MONO_ROWS + 1, MAX_M
+        if layer.attn.layer_id == 0:
+            # layer 0's attention eager break also flushes the deferred Engram
+            # all-gathers (same break count)
+            self.flush_engram = True
+            layer.attn.asm = self

+        _k2_install(self, layer, lo, hi)

+    def seam(self, *args, **kw):
+        """``mhc_pre_delayed`` on our kernels → its outputs, or None."""
+        for fn in self.seams:
+            outs = fn(*args, **kw)
+            if outs is not None:
+                return outs
+        return None
+
+    def attn(self, positions: torch.Tensor, x: torch.Tensor):
+        """The attention on our seam's y → its all-reduced output, or None."""
+        return None if self.attn_fn is None else self.attn_fn(positions, x)
+
+    def ffn(self, x: torch.Tensor):
+        """The FFN on our seam's token → its all-reduced output, or None."""
+        return None if self.ffn_fn is None else self.ffn_fn(x)
+
+    def sparse_indexer_and_attn(
+        self,
+        attn,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q: torch.Tensor | None,
+        index_q_scale: torch.Tensor | None,
+        index_weights: torch.Tensor | None,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        kv: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        out: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        """The attention's eager break (``_sparse_indexer_and_attn``): the
+        indexer top-k and the sparse attention, ours where they apply."""
+        if self.flush_engram:
+            from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.engram import eg_flush
+
+            eg_flush(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        if attn.indexer is not None and index_q is not None:
+            assert index_weights is not None
+            q_quant = (index_q, index_q_scale) if index_q_scale is not None else index_q
+            args = (hidden_states, q_quant, None, index_weights)
+            if self.idx_topk_fn is not None:
+                self.idx_topk_fn(*args)
+            else:
+                attn.indexer.indexer_op(*args)
+            if self.tk_hook is not None:
+                self.tk_hook()
+        if self.mqa_fn is not None:
+            self.mqa_fn(q, kv, positions, out)
+        else:
+            attn.forward_mqa(q, kv, positions, out)

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- K2: the FFN half

+_k2: dict = {"runner": None, "seen": set()}

+def _k2_install(h: AsmDecodeLayer, layer, lo: int, hi: int) -> None:
+    """The FFN seam call (``mhc_pre_delayed`` with ``hc_ffn_fn``) runs K2 for

+    shared."""

+    src_wide = (
+        cand is not None
+        and getattr(op, "candidate_write", False)
+        and op.candidate_block_size == 8
+        and cand.shape[1] == 2048
+        and 2048 * 8 < width <= wmax
+    )
+    gat = (
+        cand is not None
+        and not getattr(op, "candidate_write", False)
+        and op.candidate_block_size == 8
+        and cand.shape[1] == 2048
+        and width > 2048 * 8
+    )
+    wide = wide or src_wide
+    if (
+        kind not in ("RocmSparseAttnIndexer", "RocmSparseMQAIndexer")
+        or op.topk_tokens != 512
+        or (width > 4 * 512 * 18 and not (wide or gat))
+    ):
+        _log(
+            f"idx top-k: layer {attn.layer_id} keeps vLLM's op ({kind}, width {width})"
+        )
+        return
+    if (
+        cand is not None
+        and -(-width // op.candidate_block_size) > cand.shape[1]
+        and not (src_wide or gat)
+    ):
+        _log(
+            f"idx top-k: layer {attn.layer_id} keeps vLLM's op (width {width}: "
+            "candidates can filter)"
+        )
+        return
+    if gat:
+        run.idx_gather_prepare()
+    elif wide:
+        run.idx_wide_prepare(width, source=src_wide)
+    else:
+        run.idx_logits_prepare(width)
+
+    def fallback(why, *args):
+        _log_once(
+            ("idx", attn.layer_id, why),
+            f"idx top-k: vLLM's op on layer {attn.layer_id} ({why})",
+        )
+        return op(*args)
+
+    def forward(hidden_states, q_quant, k, weights):
+        args = (hidden_states, q_quant, k, weights)
+        md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        if not isinstance(md, dict):
+            return op(*args)
+        swa_md, comp_md = metadata()
+        imd: Any = md.get(op.k_cache.prefix)
+        if (
+            swa_md is None
+            or comp_md is None
+            or imd is None
+            or not isinstance(q_quant, tuple)
+        ):
+            return fallback("no metadata", *args)
+        if (
+            swa_md.num_prefills
+            or not swa_md.num_decode_tokens
+            or imd.prefill is not None
+            or imd.decode is None
+        ):
+            return fallback("not a decode step", *args)
+        if imd.decode_row_lens is None:
+            return fallback("no row lens", *args)
+        # spec decode (uniform 1 + k rows per request): vLLM's dense launch
+        # takes a request's rows as one sequence (decode_native); ours stays
+        # per row on the row lengths and row block table
+        n = swa_md.num_decode_tokens
+        lens = imd.decode_row_lens
+        rows = lens.shape[0]
+        if rows > MAX_M or rows < n:
+            return fallback(f"rows: n {n}, lens {tuple(lens.shape)}", *args)
+        lay = _layer(
+            op.k_cache.prefix,
+            op.k_cache.kv_cache,
+            q_quant[0],
+            q_quant[1],
+            weights,
+            op.topk_indices_buffer,
+            op.topk_tokens,
+            op.head_dim,
+            attn.compress_ratio,
+            cand,
+            op.candidate_block_size,
+        )
+        buf = op.topk_indices_buffer
+        flat = lay.kv.view(lay.kv.shape[0], -1)
+        nE = flat.shape[1] // 68
+        assert flat.shape[1] == nE * 68 and flat.stride(1) == 1
+        if src_wide and imd.decode_block_ends is None:
+            return fallback("no block ends", *args)
+        if gat:
+            run.idx_gather(
+                lay.q[:n],
+                lay.q_scale[:n],
+                lay.weights[:n],
+                flat,
+                flat.stride(0),
+                nE,
+                imd.decode.block_table,
+                lens[:n],
+                swa_md.is_valid_token[:n],
+                swa_md.token_to_req_indices[:n],
+                comp_md.block_table[: swa_md.num_decodes],
+                comp_md.block_size // attn.compress_ratio,
+                buf[:n],
+                cand[:n],
+            )
+        else:
+            (run.idx_wide if wide else run.idx_logits)(
+                width,
+                lay.q[:n],
+                lay.q_scale[:n],
+                lay.weights[:n],
+                flat,
+                flat.stride(0),
+                nE,
+                imd.decode.block_table,
+                lens[:n],
+                swa_md.is_valid_token[:n],
+                swa_md.token_to_req_indices[:n],
+                comp_md.block_table[: swa_md.num_decodes],
+                comp_md.block_size // attn.compress_ratio,
+                buf[:n],
+                **(
+                    dict(cand=cand[:rows], bends=imd.decode_block_ends)
+                    if src_wide
+                    else {}
+                ),
+            )
+        _k1["tk_done"] = (attn._index_source_prefix, attn.compress_ratio, n)
+        return buf
+
+    h.idx_topk_fn = forward
+    candidates = (
+        "source"
+        if getattr(op, "candidate_write", False)
+        else "consumer"
+        if cand is not None
+        else "none"
+    )
+    _log(
+        f"idx top-k on layer {attn.layer_id} ({kind}, width {width}, "
+        f"candidates {candidates})"
+    )
+
+
+def _k1_install(h: AsmDecodeLayer, layer, lo: int, hi: int) -> None:
+    """One consumer layer (compress ratio > 0, no compressor without an
+    indexer) or index layer, in the three pieces of vLLM's breakable graph:
+
+    - the attention seam (``mhc_pre_delayed`` with ``hc_attn_fn``) runs ours
+      and returns vLLM's outputs with y' = bf16(x1 · norm.w) (the row's rstd is
+      applied downstream) as the attention input;
+    - ``attn`` on that y': our front (on index layers also the indexer's wq_b
+      and q quant in the same launches, while vLLM's weights_proj and the
+      compressor (GEMM + comp_tail) run on its aux streams), then vLLM's
+      ``_sparse_indexer_and_attn`` eager break, where ``forward_mqa`` runs our
+      sparse attention on decode-only steps (vLLM's own on mixed steps, its
+      MXFP8 output converted to our layout), then our back with all-reduce #1.
+    """
+    _wob_setup()
+    attn = layer.attn
+    index = attn.indexer is not None
+    if attn.compress_ratio <= 0 or (attn.compressor is not None and not index):
+        if getattr(layer, "engram", None) is not None:
+            # layer 1: our seam, vLLM's attention
+            _eg_seam_only_install(h, layer, lo, hi)
+        return
+    if attn.kv_mxfp8 or attn.kv_cache_dtype != "fp8_ds_mla":
+        _log(f"K1 off for layer {attn.layer_id}: a {attn.kv_cache_dtype} KV cache")
+        return
+    assert not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing(), (
+        "K1 must be set up outside graph capture"
+    )
+    run = _k1_runner()
+    attn.asm = h
+
+    def metadata():
+        md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        if not isinstance(md, dict):
+            return None, None
+        return md.get(attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix), md.get(attn.compressed_cache_prefix)
+
+    if index:
+        # After every index source's top-k (on our kernels or not, e.g. the
+        # Engram layer 14), map it into the runner's fixed-stride lists once;
+        # this layer and its consumers read them instead of vLLM's ragged
+        # pack. tk_src names the source, ratio and row count the lists are
+        # for; anything else falls back.
+        def tk_hook():
+            done = _k1.pop("tk_done", None)
+            _k1["tk_src"] = None
+            swa_md, comp_md = metadata()
+            if (
+                swa_md is None
+                or comp_md is None
+                or swa_md.num_prefills
+                or not swa_md.num_decode_tokens
+            ):
+                return
+            n = swa_md.num_decode_tokens
+            if n > MAX_M or attn.topk_indices_buffer.shape[1] != 512:
+                return
+            src = (attn._index_source_prefix, attn.compress_ratio, n)
+            if done != src:
+                # vLLM's top-k ran: our top-k writes the lists itself
+                run.translate(
+                    attn.topk_indices_buffer[:n],
+                    swa_md.token_to_req_indices[:n],
+                    swa_md.is_valid_token[:n],
+                    comp_md.block_table[: swa_md.num_decodes],
+                    comp_md.block_size // attn.compress_ratio,
+                )
+            # what vLLM's source does with fresh indices
+            attn._topk_ragged_cache = {}
+            _k1["tk_src"] = src
+
+        h.tk_hook = tk_hook
+        _idx_topk_install(h, attn, run, metadata)
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.rocm import DeepseekV41RocmMxfp4Indexer
+
+        assert isinstance(attn.indexer, DeepseekV41RocmMxfp4Indexer), type(attn.indexer)
+    w = run.weights(layer, v3=True)
+    _log(f"K1 on {'index ' if index else ''}layer {attn.layer_id}")
+    state: dict = {"y": None}
+
+    if getattr(layer, "engram", None) is not None:
+        layer.engram._eg_seam_range = (lo, hi)
+
+    def seam_forward(*args, **kw):
+        outs = _eg_seam(layer, run, w, args, kw, v3=True, idx=index)
+        if outs is not None:
+            state["y"] = outs[3]
+            return outs
+        residual: Any = args[0] if args else None
+        mixes: list[Any] = [
+            kw.get(k)
+            for k in ("sublayer_out", "pre_mix", "post_layer_mix", "comb_res_mix")
+        ]
+        sub, pre_mix, post_mix, res_mix = mixes
+        m = residual.shape[0] if residual is not None else 0
+        swa_md, _ = metadata()
+        if (
+            len(args) < 2
+            or args[1] is not layer.hc_attn_fn
+            or kw.get("x") is not None
+            or any(t is None for t in (sub, pre_mix, post_mix, res_mix))
+            or residual.dim() != 3
+            or not lo <= m <= hi
+            or swa_md is None
+            or kw.get("norm_weight") is None
+        ):
+            # ours needs the norm fused into the seam (its y is a placeholder)
+            return None
+        r_new, post, comb, y, pre = run.seam_v3(
+            w,
+            residual.contiguous(),
+            sub.contiguous(),
+            post_mix.contiguous(),
+            res_mix.contiguous(),
+            pre_mix.contiguous(),
+            idx=index,
+        )
+        state["y"] = y
+        return r_new, post, comb, y, pre
+
+    def mqa_forward(q, kv, positions, output):
+        # The eager break re-invokes this at every graph replay with the
+        # captured arguments (attn_forward doesn't run then): our q buffer
+        # marks our calls.
+        swa_md, comp_md = metadata()
+        if q.data_ptr() != run.s["q"].data_ptr() or swa_md is None:
+            attn.forward_mqa(q, kv, positions, output)
+            return
+        m = q.shape[0]
+        if swa_md.num_prefills == 0 and swa_md.decode_swa_ragged_indices is not None:
+            # rows past n are graph padding (outputs dropped)
+            n = swa_md.num_decode_tokens
+            q = q[:n]
+            positions = positions[:n]
+            tk_idx = tk_ptr = None
+            fixed = comp_md is not None and _k1.get("tk_src") == (
+                attn._index_source_prefix,
+                attn.compress_ratio,
+                n,
+            )
+            if fixed:
+                tk_idx, tk_ptr = run.s["tk"], run.s["tk_lens"]
+            elif comp_md is not None:
+                tk_idx, tk_ptr, _ = attn._decode_topk_ragged(
+                    swa_metadata=swa_md,
+                    attn_metadata=comp_md,
+                    num_decodes=swa_md.num_decodes,
+                    num_decode_tokens=n,
+                )
+                _log_once(
+                    ("tk", attn.layer_id),
+                    f"layer {attn.layer_id} took vLLM's ragged top-k (fixed "
+                    f"lists are for {_k1.get('tk_src')}, M = {n})",
+                )
+            run.attend(
+                w,
+                q,
+                positions,
+                attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache,
+                swa_md.block_size,
+                swa_md.decode_swa_ragged_indices,
+                swa_md.decode_swa_ragged_indptr,
+                attn._compressed_kv_cache() if comp_md is not None else None,
+                comp_md.block_size // attn.compress_ratio if comp_md is not None else 0,
+                tk_idx,
+                tk_ptr,
+                fixed=fixed,
+                v3=True,
+            )
+            return
+        # mixed step: vLLM's attention for every row (on q · rrms), then into
+        # our layout
+        run.q_rr(q, float(attn.eps))
+        attn.forward_mqa(q, kv, positions, output)
+        run.from_attn_out(output.data, output.scale, m)
+        _log_once("mixed", "mixed step: vLLM's attention + layout conversion")
+
+    # the compressor's GEMM (comp_gemm: split-K partials) + save / pool / norm,
+    # compressed insert and the indexer K store in one launch (comp_tail) on
+    # the aux stream, instead of vLLM's aux launches + wk and the K store after
+    # the join
+    ctail: dict | None = None
+    if index and attn.compressor is not None:
+        comp, idxr = attn.compressor, attn.indexer
+        if comp.pcp_size == 1 and idxr.owns_k and idxr.use_fp4_kv:
+            from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm import comp_tail as ct
+            from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_paged_mxfp4_indexer import (
+                rocm_paged_mxfp4_cache_layout,
+            )
+
+            cw = comp.fused_wkv_wgate.weight.data
+            # one partial buffer for all layers (their aux chains don't
+            # overlap)
+            key = ("comp_part", cw.shape[0])
+            if key not in _k1:
+                _k1[key] = torch.empty(16, MAX_M, cw.shape[0], device=cw.device)
+            ctail = dict(
+                fn=ct.comp_tail,
+                lat=torch.empty(
+                    MAX_M, 512, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=comp.norm.weight.device
+                ),
+                wk=idxr.wk.weight.data.contiguous(),
+                layout=rocm_paged_mxfp4_cache_layout,
+                gemm=dict(
+                    fn=ct.comp_gemm, cfg=ct.gemm_cfg, w=cw.contiguous(), part=_k1[key]
+                ),
+            )
+
+    norm_eps = float(layer.attn_norm.variance_epsilon)
+    if index:
+        # the weights' scale as vLLM's q quant gets it
+        # (rocm_mxfp4_indexer_q_quant: softmax_scale · head_scale) (as the
+        # kernel's f32 argument: 128^-½ · 32^-½ is 0.015625000000000003 in
+        # double, 2^-6 in f32)
+        w_scale = struct.unpack(
+            "<f",
+            struct.pack("<f", attn.indexer.softmax_scale * attn.indexer.n_head**-0.5),
+        )[0]
+        w_pow2 = math.frexp(w_scale)[0] == 0.5
+        if "idx_wf" not in _k1:
+            _k1["idx_wf"] = torch.empty(
+                MAX_M, attn.indexer.n_head, device=attn.indexer.wq_b.weight.device
+            )
+        w_f32 = _k1["idx_wf"]
+        assert (
+            attn.indexer.use_fp4_kv
+            and attn.indexer.indexer_weights_dtype == torch.float32
+        )
+
+    def y_of(yp):
+        """Y = bf16(y' · rstd), vLLM's attention input, for vLLM's compressor
+        (fallbacks); rstd[t] from the attention seam's partials (Σx1² at 25 of
+        each slice's 32)."""
+        rstd = torch.rsqrt(
+            run.s["partial"][: yp.shape[0], :, 25].sum(-1) / H + norm_eps
+        )
+        return (yp.float() * rstd[:, None]).to(yp.dtype)
+
+    def comp_tail_run(hidden_states, positions, attn_md):
+        """comp_gemm + comp_tail on this layer's caches → True; False: not
+        applicable here (nothing ran; vLLM's chain runs instead)."""
+        comp, idxr = attn.compressor, attn.indexer
+        assert ctail is not None
+        if not isinstance(attn_md, dict):
+            return False
+        ccl = comp._static_forward_context[comp.k_cache_prefix]
+        cslots = attn_md[comp.k_cache_prefix].slot_mapping
+        kslots = attn_md[idxr.k_cache.prefix].slot_mapping
+        ccache, kcache = ccl.kv_cache, idxr.k_cache.kv_cache
+        if (
+            ccache.dtype != torch.uint8
+            or ccache.shape[-1] != 584
+            or cslots.numel() > MAX_M
+        ):
+            return False
+        if comp.state_cache is not None:
+            smd = attn_md[comp.state_cache.prefix]
+            st, ss = comp.state_cache.kv_cache, smd.slot_mapping
+            qsl, req = smd.query_start_loc, smd.token_to_req_indices
+        else:
+            st, ss, qsl, req = None, cslots, None, None
+        shuffle = ctail["layout"](idxr.n_head, idxr.head_dim, kcache.shape[1])
+        g = ctail["gemm"]
+        cfg = g["cfg"](hidden_states.shape[0], g["w"].shape[0])
+        kv_score, split = g["fn"](hidden_states, g["w"], g["part"], cfg), cfg["split"]
+        if split == 1:
+            kv_score = kv_score[0, : hidden_states.shape[0]]
+        # hidden_states = y' (no rstd): comp_tail applies it from the seam's
+        # partials
+        ctail["fn"](
+            kv_score,
+            positions,
+            comp.compress_ratio,
+            st,
+            ss,
+            qsl,
+            req,
+            comp.norm.weight,
+            float(comp.rms_norm_eps),
+            ctail["lat"],
+            ccache,
+            cslots,
+            attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            ctail["wk"],
+            idxr.k_norm.weight,
+            float(idxr.k_norm.variance_epsilon),
+            attn.indexer_rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            kcache,
+            kslots,
+            shuffle,
+            split,
+            rs_part=run.s["partial"],
+            rs_eps=norm_eps,
+        )
+        return True
+
+    def index_front(positions, hidden_states, m, swa_md):
+        """Our front + the indexer's wq_b, q RoPE and MXFP4 q on the default
+        stream; the compressor (comp_gemm + comp_tail, or vLLM's chain) and
+        weights_proj on the aux streams; then the indexer K store (unless
+        comp_tail did it) → (q, index q, its scales, index weights)."""
+        from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+        from vllm.utils.multi_stream_utils import execute_in_parallel
+
+        indexer, comp = attn.indexer, attn.compressor
+        attn_md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+
+        def default_chain():
+            q = run.front_v3(
+                w,
+                m,
+                positions,
+                swa_md.slot_mapping,
+                attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache,
+                swa_md.block_size,
+                idx=True,
+            )
+            return q, None
+
+        def weights_chain():
+            wr = indexer.weights_proj(hidden_states)[0]
+            # vLLM's q quant scales the weights (fp32) by softmax_scale ·
+            # n_head^-½ (2^-6 here: exact in bf16)
+            if w_pow2:
+                return torch.mul(wr, w_scale, out=w_f32[:m])
+            return wr.float() * w_scale
+
+        def compressor_chain():
+            if ctail is not None and comp_tail_run(hidden_states, positions, attn_md):
+                # K stored too
+                return None
+            kv_score = torch.mm(
+                y_of(hidden_states),
+                comp.fused_wkv_wgate.weight.T,
+                out_dtype=torch.float32,
+            )
+            latent = comp(kv_score, positions)
+            comp.insert_cache(latent, positions, attn.rotary_emb)
+            return latent
+
+        fns: list[Callable[[], Any] | None] = [weights_chain]
+        if comp is not None:
+            fns.insert(0, compressor_chain)
+        aux = attn.aux_stream_list
+        enable = aux is not None and current_platform.enable_multi_stream_overlap(
+            aux, attn_md
+        )
+        (q, _), res = execute_in_parallel(
+            default_chain,
+            fns,
+            attn.ln_events[0],
+            attn.ln_events[1 : 1 + len(fns)],
+            aux[: len(fns)] if enable else None,
+            enable=enable,
+            default_first=True,
+        )
+        if comp is not None and res[0] is not None:
+            indexer._produce_k(res[0], positions, attn.indexer_rotary_emb)
+        iq, iq_scale = run.idx_q3(m)
+        return q, iq, iq_scale, res[-1]
+
+    def attn_forward(positions, hidden_states):
+        if state["y"] is None or hidden_states is not state["y"]:
+            return None
+        state["y"] = None
+        m = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        swa_md, _ = metadata()
+        if m not in _k1["seen"]:
+            _k1["seen"].add(m)
+            _log(f"K1 at M = {m}")
+        if index:
+            q, iq, iq_scale, iw = index_front(positions, hidden_states, m, swa_md)
+        else:
+            q = run.front_v3(
+                w,
+                m,
+                positions,
+                swa_md.slot_mapping,
+                attn.swa_cache_layer.kv_cache,
+                swa_md.block_size,
+            )
+            iq = iq_scale = iw = None
+        attn_out = attn._alloc_attn_out(m, hidden_states)
+        attn._sparse_indexer_and_attn(
+            hidden_states, iq, iq_scale, iw, q, q, positions, attn_out
+        )
+        return run.back_ar(w, m, positions, _wob["wob"], WIRE)
+
+    h.seams.append(seam_forward)
+    h.attn_fn = attn_forward
+    h.mqa_fn = mqa_forward
+

+def _eg_seam(layer, run, w, args, kw, v3=False, idx=False):
+    """If the layer's Engram forward left (r', gates, value) for this seam call,
+    run our seam on it as a post-mix → vLLM's seam outputs with r'' as the new
+    residual. None: nothing pending (an ordinary call)."""
+    eng = getattr(layer, "engram", None)
+    pend = eng.__dict__.pop("_eg_pending", None) if eng is not None else None
+    if pend is None:
+        return None
+    r1, gates, value = pend
+    assert (
+        len(args) >= 2
+        and args[1] is layer.hc_attn_fn
+        and args[0] is r1
+        and kw.get("sublayer_out") is None
+        and kw.get("x") is None
+        and kw.get("pre_mix") is not None
+    ), "Engram: unexpected seam call"
+    if v3 and kw.get("norm_weight") is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "Engram on our seam needs the attention norm fused into the seam"
+        )
+    pre = kw["pre_mix"].contiguous()
+    if v3:
+        return run.seam_eg_v3(w, r1, value, gates, pre, idx=idx)
+    return run.seam_eg(w, r1, value, gates, pre)
+
+
+def _eg_seam_only_install(h: AsmDecodeLayer, layer, lo: int, hi: int) -> None:
+    """Our seam on an Engram layer whose attention stays vLLM's (layer 1, ratio

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Engram: the IPC all-gather (kernels/eg_ag.py) across the 4 TP
+processes. ``dst`` and the flags are hipMalloc'd per rank and shared through
+IPC handles (ar_runner.ipc_alloc); ``dst`` is persistent, so its rows can be
+read by a later graph segment.
+
+    # once per process, outside graph capture
+    ag = IpcAllGather(rank, cpu_group, row_bytes, max_m)
+    # src [m, ...] (row_bytes per row) on this rank
+    # → out [m, 4 · row_bytes / es], same dtype
+    out = ag(src)
+
+Every rank must make the same calls in the same order (seq counters, as
+ar_runner). ``out`` is a view of the persistent buffer: the next call
+overwrites it.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.ar_runner import flag_state, ipc_alloc
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels import eg_ag
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels.kmod import Kernel
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+class _Cai:
+    def __init__(self, ptr: int, nbytes: int):
+        self.__cuda_array_interface__ = {
+            "data": (ptr, False),
+            "shape": (nbytes,),
+            "typestr": "|u1",
+            "version": 3,
+        }
+
+
+def device_bytes(ptr: int, nbytes: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """uint8 tensor over raw device memory (no copy, not owned)."""
+    return torch.as_tensor(_Cai(ptr, nbytes), device="cuda")
+
+
+class IpcAllGather:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        rank: int,
+        cpu_group,
+        row_bytes: int,
+        max_m: int = 256,
+        world: int = 4,
+        g: int = eg_ag.G,
+        split: bool = False,
+    ):
+        assert world == 4, "eg_ag is written for TP4"
+        self.rank, self.b, self.max_m, self.g = rank, row_bytes, max_m, g
+        mine, every = ipc_alloc(
+            dict(dst=max_m * 4 * row_bytes, flags=eg_ag.flag_bytes(g)),
+            rank,
+            cpu_group,
+            world,
+        )
+        self.ptrs = {f"dst{d}": every["dst"][d] for d in range(4)}
+        self.ptrs.update({f"flags{d}": every["flags"][d] for d in range(4)})
+        self.flags_mine = mine["flags"]
+        self.flag_layout = (
+            eg_ag.flag_bytes(g),
+            1,
+        )  # (bytes, hops), for IPC diagnostics
+        self.dst = device_bytes(mine["dst"], max_m * 4 * row_bytes)
+        k = eg_ag.source(rank, row_bytes, g=g)
+        self.k = Kernel(k["name"], k["src"], k["ka"])
+        if split:  # the push split: push() on one stream, wait() on another
+            self.k_push, self.k_wait = (
+                Kernel(d["name"], d["src"], d["ka"])
+                for d in (
+                    eg_ag.source(rank, row_bytes, g=g, phase=ph)
+                    for ph in ("push", "wait")
+                )
+            )
+        torch.distributed.barrier(group=cpu_group)
+
+    def __call__(self, src: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        m = src.shape[0]
+        assert (
+            src.is_contiguous()
+            and src[0].numel() * src.element_size() == self.b
+            and 1 <= m <= self.max_m
+        ), (src.shape, src.dtype, self.b)
+        self.k(self.g, 64, **self.ptrs, src=src, m=m)
+        return (
+            self.dst[: m * 4 * self.b]
+            .view(src.dtype)
+            .view(m, 4 * self.b // src.element_size())
+        )
+
+    def push(self, src: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Every peer's dst gets src (and its flag); returns without waiting for the
+        peers."""
+        m = src.shape[0]
+        assert (
+            src.is_contiguous()
+            and src[0].numel() * src.element_size() == self.b
+            and 1 <= m <= self.max_m
+        )
+        self.k_push(self.g, 64, **self.ptrs, src=src, m=m)
+
+    def wait(self, m: int, like: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Waits for the peers' pushes of the launch this rank's last push() counted; →
+        the gathered rows (as __call__). Must run after that push (stream order or an
+        event)."""
+        self.k_wait(self.g, 64, **self.ptrs, src=like, m=m)
+        return (
+            self.dst[: m * 4 * self.b]
+            .view(like.dtype)
+            .view(m, 4 * self.b // like.element_size())
+        )
+
+    def errors(self) -> int:
+        """Poll timeouts so far (CTAs with a nonzero err word)."""
+        return sum(e != 0 for e in self.state()[1])
+
+    def state(self) -> tuple[list, list]:
+        """(ctr, err) per CTA: launches so far, and the seq of the last timed-out launch
+        (0: none). Syncs."""
+        return flag_state(self.flags_mine, eg_ag.flag_bytes(self.g), self.g)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- resharded wkv, gate
+# exchange
+
+RANK_K, RANK_ROW = (
+    1536,
+    1584,
+)  # per rank: 6 columns × 256 MXFP8 codes, then their 48 E8M0 scales
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["M"])
+def _side_gemm_packed_kernel(
+    x_ptr,
+    xs_ptr,
+    w_ptr,
+    ws_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    M,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    K: tl.constexpr,
+    RK: tl.constexpr,
+    RROW: tl.constexpr,
+    RANKS: tl.constexpr,
+    PLANE_N: tl.constexpr,
+    PLANE_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_M: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_N: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    NPROG: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """VLLM's _block32_tiled_kernel loop (MXFP8 x, 32×32 block-scaled e4m3 w, no split
+    K), persistent (program p takes output tiles p, p + NPROG, .., column tiles fastest,
+    so the grid stays small next to the main stream), on the all-gathered packed rows:
+    row = RANKS × [RK codes | RK/32 scales] (x_ptr / xs_ptr are fp8 / uint8 views of the
+    same buffer), K = RANKS · RK in the same order as vLLM's gathered input. Output
+    column n goes to plane n // PLANE_N (rows of PLANE_N, planes PLANE_STRIDE apart)."""
+    grid_n: tl.constexpr = N // BLOCK_N
+    tiles = tl.cdiv(M, BLOCK_M) * grid_n
+    for tile in range(tl.program_id(0), tiles, NPROG):
+        pid_m = tile // grid_n
+        pid_n = tile % grid_n
+        offs_m = pid_m * BLOCK_M + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_M)
+        offs_n = pid_n * BLOCK_N + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_N)
+        m_mask = offs_m < M
+        offs_k = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+        offs_sk = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K // 32)
+        acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N), dtype=tl.float32)
+        for d in tl.static_range(RANKS):
+            x_ptrs = (
+                x_ptr + offs_m[:, None] * (RANKS * RROW) + d * RROW + offs_k[None, :]
+            )
+            xs_ptrs = (
+                xs_ptr
+                + offs_m[:, None] * (RANKS * RROW)
+                + d * RROW
+                + RK
+                + offs_sk[None, :]
+            )
+            w_ptrs = w_ptr + offs_n[:, None] * K + d * RK + offs_k[None, :]
+            ws_ptrs = (
+                ws_ptr
+                + (offs_n[:, None] // 32) * (K // 32)
+                + d * (RK // 32)
+                + offs_sk[None, :]
+            )
+            for _ in range(0, RK, BLOCK_K):
+                x = tl.load(x_ptrs, mask=m_mask[:, None], other=0.0)
+                xs = tl.load(xs_ptrs, mask=m_mask[:, None], other=0)
+                w = tl.load(w_ptrs)
+                ws = tl.load(ws_ptrs)
+                acc = tl.dot_scaled(x, xs, "e4m3", w.T, ws, "e4m3", acc=acc)
+                x_ptrs += BLOCK_K
+                w_ptrs += BLOCK_K
+                xs_ptrs += BLOCK_K // 32
+                ws_ptrs += BLOCK_K // 32
+        plane = pid_n * BLOCK_N // PLANE_N
+        cols = offs_n - plane * PLANE_N
+        tl.store(
+            out_ptr + plane * PLANE_STRIDE + offs_m[:, None] * PLANE_N + cols[None, :],
+            acc.to(out_ptr.dtype.element_ty),
+            mask=m_mask[:, None],
+        )
+
+
+def side_gemm_packed(
+    g: torch.Tensor,
+    w: torch.Tensor,
+    ws: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    nprog: int = 0,
+    block_n: int = 0,
+    block_k: int = 256,
+    block_m: int = 0,
+    num_warps: int = 0,
+    num_stages: int = 2,
+) -> None:
+    """Out [M, N] bf16 = gathered MXFP8 rows g (uint8 [M, 4 · RANK_ROW]) @ w.T
+    (e4m3 [N, 4 · RANK_K], block scales ws [N/32, K/32]); or out [P, ≥ M, N/P]
+    (planes, e.g. [key | value]: column n in plane n // (N/P)). nprog 0: one program
+    per output tile (short CTAs, vLLM-like); else persistent on nprog. Default
+    tiles from eg_gemm_tune.py (N 10240): M ≤ 128 64 × 64 × 256, 4 warps;
+    else 128 × 128 × 256, 8 warps (23 / 28 / 37 µs at M 64 / 128 / 256)."""
+    M = g.shape[0]
+    N, K = w.shape
+    ranks = g.shape[1] // RANK_ROW
+    big = M > 128
+    block_n = block_n or (128 if big else 64)
+    num_warps = num_warps or (8 if big else 4)
+    block_m = block_m or (128 if big else min(64, max(16, triton.next_power_of_2(M))))
+    if out.dim() == 2:
+        assert out.shape == (M, N) and out.is_contiguous()
+        plane_n, plane_stride = N, 0
+    else:
+        plane_n, plane_stride = out.shape[2], out.stride(0)
+        assert (
+            out.shape[0] * plane_n == N
+            and out.shape[1] >= M
+            and out.stride(1) == plane_n
+            and out.stride(2) == 1
+        )
+    assert ranks * RANK_K == K and plane_n % block_n == 0 and RANK_K % block_k == 0
+    tiles = triton.cdiv(M, block_m) * (N // block_n)
+    nprog = tiles if nprog <= 0 else min(nprog, tiles)
+    _side_gemm_packed_kernel[(nprog,)](
+        g.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        g,
+        w,
+        ws,
+        out,
+        M,
+        N,
+        K,
+        RANK_K,
+        RANK_ROW,
+        ranks,
+        plane_n,
+        plane_stride,
+        BLOCK_M=block_m,
+        BLOCK_N=block_n,
+        BLOCK_K=block_k,
+        NPROG=nprog,
+        num_warps=num_warps,
+        num_stages=num_stages,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _eg_gate_kernel(
+    hidden_states,
+    key,
+    q_weight,
+    k_weight,
+    token_mask,
+    gate_out,
+    hidden_stride_t,
+    key_stride_t,
+    eps,
+    clamp_value,
+    HC: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_MASK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """VLLM's _fused_engram_post_wkv_kernel up to the gate, for hc copy HC
+    (this rank's key) only; the same arithmetic, so the same gate bits."""
+    token_idx = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    dim_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    dim_valid = dim_offsets < DIM
+    hidden = tl.load(
+        hidden_states + token_idx * hidden_stride_t + HC * DIM + dim_offsets,
+        mask=dim_valid,
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    key = tl.load(
+        key + token_idx * key_stride_t + dim_offsets, mask=dim_valid, other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    q = tl.load(q_weight + HC * DIM + dim_offsets, mask=dim_valid, other=0.0).to(
+        tl.float32
+    )
+    k = tl.load(k_weight + HC * DIM + dim_offsets, mask=dim_valid, other=0.0).to(
+        tl.float32
+    )
+    hidden_rms = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(hidden * hidden, axis=0) / DIM + eps)
+    key_rms = tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(key * key, axis=0) / DIM + eps)
+    dot = tl.sum(hidden * q * k * key, axis=0)
+    dot *= hidden_rms * key_rms * tl.rsqrt(DIM * 1.0)
+    gate_input = tl.sqrt(tl.maximum(tl.abs(dot), clamp_value))
+    gate_input = tl.where(dot < 0.0, -gate_input, gate_input)
+    gate = tl.sigmoid(gate_input)
+    if HAS_MASK:
+        gate = tl.where(tl.load(token_mask + token_idx), gate, 0.0)
+    tl.store(gate_out + token_idx * 4, gate)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _eg_out_kernel(
+    hidden_states,
+    value,
+    gates,
+    output,
+    hidden_stride_t,
+    value_stride_t,
+    HC_MULT: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """VLLM's kernel after the gate: out[t, h] = copy + gate[t, h] · value[t]
+    (gates: all-gathered, copy h's at [t, 4 h])."""
+    program_idx = tl.program_id(0)
+    token_idx = (program_idx // HC_MULT).to(tl.int64)
+    hc_idx = program_idx % HC_MULT
+    dim_offsets = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    dim_valid = dim_offsets < DIM
+    hidden = tl.load(
+        hidden_states + token_idx * hidden_stride_t + hc_idx * DIM + dim_offsets,
+        mask=dim_valid,
+        other=0.0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    gate = tl.load(gates + token_idx * (4 * HC_MULT) + 4 * hc_idx)
+    v = tl.load(
+        value + token_idx * value_stride_t + dim_offsets, mask=dim_valid, other=0.0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(
+        output + token_idx * hidden_stride_t + hc_idx * DIM + dim_offsets,
+        hidden + gate * v,
+        mask=dim_valid,
+    )
+
+
+def eg_gate(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    key: torch.Tensor,
+    q_weight,
+    k_weight,
+    token_mask,
+    gate_out: torch.Tensor,
+    hc: int,
+    eps: float,
+    clamp: float,
+) -> None:
+    n, hc_mult, dim = hidden.shape
+    assert (
+        hidden.stride(2) == 1
+        and hidden.stride(1) == dim
+        and key.stride(1) == 1
+        and gate_out.shape[1] == 4
+    )
+    assert q_weight.is_contiguous() and k_weight.is_contiguous()
+    block = triton.next_power_of_2(dim)
+    mask = token_mask if token_mask is not None else hidden
+    _eg_gate_kernel[(n,)](
+        hidden,
+        key,
+        q_weight,
+        k_weight,
+        mask,
+        gate_out,
+        hidden.stride(0),
+        key.stride(0),
+        eps,
+        clamp,
+        HC=hc,
+        DIM=dim,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=block,
+        HAS_MASK=token_mask is not None,
+        num_warps=8 if block >= 2048 else 4,
+    )
+
+
+def eg_out(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor, value: torch.Tensor, gates: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    n, hc_mult, dim = hidden.shape
+    assert (
+        hidden.is_contiguous()
+        and value.stride(1) == 1
+        and gates.shape == (n, 4 * hc_mult)
+        and gates.is_contiguous()
+    )
+    out = torch.empty_like(hidden)
+    block = triton.next_power_of_2(dim)
+    _eg_out_kernel[(n * hc_mult,)](
+        hidden,
+        value,
+        gates,
+        out,
+        hidden.stride(0),
+        value.stride(0),
+        HC_MULT=hc_mult,
+        DIM=dim,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=block,
+        num_warps=8 if block >= 2048 else 4,
+    )
+    return out

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Engram (layers 1, 14) with the asm decode layers: the wkv projection of the
+looked-up rows depends only on the hash ids, so the prefetch stream runs it
+right after the lookup (eager, as vLLM's prefetch) and the layer's forward
+keeps only the gate on the critical path (_EngramSide); the layer's attention
+seam (ours) applies gate · value as its post-mix. M ≤ 256 only; anything else
+is vLLM's path."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.compilation.breakable_cudagraph import (
+    BreakableCUDAGraphCapture,
+    eager_break_during_capture,
+)
+from vllm.distributed import get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size, get_tp_group
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+    mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+)
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.decode import MONO_ROWS
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.common.engram import Engram
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+_eg: dict = {"seen": set(), "deferred": []}
+EG_MAX_M = 256
+
+
+def eg_flush(main) -> None:
+    """Issues the deferred rows pushes on ``main`` and the waits + side GEMMs on
+    each Engram layer's prefetch stream."""
+    while _eg["deferred"]:
+        side, engram, n, src = _eg["deferred"].pop(0)
+        side.issue(engram, n, src, main, engram._prefetch_stream)
+
+
+class _EngramSide:
+    """One Engram layer's side chain. wkv resharded once (collective, at
+    creation): rank r computes [key of hc copy r | the whole value] (10240
+    columns) instead of 6400 columns of kv, so no kv all-gather. Side chain:
+    MXFP8 quant of the rank's own rows (vLLM's op; the 32-blocks sit inside the
+    256-wide hash columns, so the codes are those of vLLM's quant of the
+    gathered rows), all-gather of [codes | scales], GEMM into a persistent
+    buffer. The rows all-gather is split: the main stream pushes (at layer 0's
+    attention eager break, when the lookups are long done), the prefetch stream
+    waits. Critical path: gate of copy r, all-gather of the 4 gates (16 B per
+    token); the next attention seam applies copy + gate · value."""
+
+    def __init__(self, engram):
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.eg_runner import RANK_ROW, IpcAllGather
+
+        tp = get_tp_group()
+        r, world = tp.rank_in_group, tp.world_size
+        D, hc = engram.dim, engram.hc_mult
+        w, ws = engram.wkv.weight.data, engram.wkv.weight_scale.data
+        assert w.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn and ws.shape[0] * 32 == w.shape[0], (
+            w.dtype,
+            w.shape,
+            ws.shape,
+        )
+        assert world * w.shape[0] == (hc + 1) * D and D % 32 == 0
+        full_w = torch.empty(
+            world * w.shape[0], w.shape[1], dtype=torch.uint8, device=w.device
+        )
+        full_ws = torch.empty(
+            world * ws.shape[0], ws.shape[1], dtype=torch.uint8, device=w.device
+        )
+        dist.all_gather_into_tensor(
+            full_w, w.view(torch.uint8).contiguous(), group=tp.device_group
+        )
+        dist.all_gather_into_tensor(full_ws, ws.contiguous(), group=tp.device_group)
+        self.w = (
+            torch.cat([full_w[r * D : (r + 1) * D], full_w[hc * D :]])
+            .view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+            .contiguous()
+        )
+        b = D // 32
+        self.ws = torch.cat(
+            [full_ws[r * b : (r + 1) * b], full_ws[hc * b :]]
+        ).contiguous()
+        del full_w, full_ws
+        self.r, self.D = r, D
+        self.ag_rows = IpcAllGather(
+            r, tp.cpu_group, RANK_ROW, EG_MAX_M, world, split=True
+        )
+        self.ag_gate = IpcAllGather(r, tp.cpu_group, 16, EG_MAX_M, world)
+        # [key | value] planes
+        self.kv2 = torch.zeros(2, EG_MAX_M, D, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=w.device)
+        self.gate = torch.zeros(EG_MAX_M, 4, dtype=torch.float32, device=w.device)
+
+    def run(self, engram, rows, main):
+        """On the prefetch stream (current): the quant, then the push / wait +
+        GEMM (issue), deferred to layer 0's attention eager break above the mono
+        decode layer's rows."""
+        n = rows.shape[0]
+        xq, xs = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(rows.reshape(n, -1))
+        if not hasattr(self, "src_buf"):
+            self.src_buf = torch.empty(
+                EG_MAX_M, xq.shape[1] + xs.shape[1], dtype=torch.uint8, device=xq.device
+            )
+            self.ev_q, self.ev_ag = torch.cuda.Event(), torch.cuda.Event()
+        src = self.src_buf[:n]
+        torch.cat([xq.view(torch.uint8), xs], dim=1, out=src)
+        prefetch = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        self.ev_q.record(prefetch)
+        if n > MONO_ROWS:
+            _eg["deferred"].append((self, engram, n, src))
+            return "deferred"
+        self.issue(engram, n, src, main, prefetch, record=False)
+        return None
+
+    def issue(self, engram, n, src, main, prefetch, record=True):
+        """The rows push on ``main`` after the quant (ev_q), then on the
+        prefetch stream the push's wait and the side GEMM; record: then
+        _prefetch_done."""
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.eg_runner import side_gemm_packed

+    # captured: wqkv, norms + SWA insert, wq_b
+    q = run.front_v3(w, m, positions, slots, swa_cache, swa_bs)
+    # eager break: sparse attention → o (frag)
+    run.attend(w, q, ..., v3=True)
+    # ... or vLLM's MXFP8 attention output → o (mixed steps)
+    run.from_attn_out(attn_out, m)
+    # captured: wo_a, wo_b with all-reduce #1 folded in
+    out = run.back_ar(w, m, pos, wob, wire)

+The v1 pieces (``seam``, ``front``, ``idx_q``, ``back``) serve the Engram
+seam and the v3 pieces' internals.
+
+After an index source's top-k, ``run.translate(...)`` maps it through the
+block table into the scratch's fixed-stride lists (token t at t·512, counts in
+``tk_lens``), which ``attend(.., fixed=True)`` reads instead of vLLM's ragged
+pack (4 launches). ``run.idx_logits(...)`` (kernels/idx_logits.py) computes
+the indexer's MXFP4 logits and writes the same lists from its top-512 in one
+launch, in place of vLLM's logits, top-k and translate (``idx_wide`` /
+``idx_gather``: wide rows and the candidate source / consumers).
+
+v3 (``K1Runner(v3=True)``):
+``seam_v3`` runs the seam main only (y' = MXFP8(x1 · attn_norm.w) into wqkv's
+x, no fin; post / comb / pre come back empty and are filled by ``front_v3``),

+norm's rrms, which ``attend(.., v3=True)`` folds into its score scale (and

+placeholder: on consumer layers vLLM only passes it on to our attention.

+    def idx_q3(self, m):
+        """front_v3(.., idx=True)'s indexer q as vLLM's rocm_mxfp4_indexer_q_quant
+        returns it: (codes [M, 32, 64] uint8, E8M0 scales as one int32 per head [M, 32])

+    def q_rr(self, q, eps):
+        """v3's q · rrms (rr = rstd · rsq(rstd² · Σ / 1280 + eps), front_v3's partials)
+        for vLLM's attention (mixed steps; eager), bf16 in place."""
+        m = q.shape[0]
+        rd = self.s["rstd"][:m]
+        ss = self.s["ss"].view(MAX_M, 40)[:m].sum(-1)
+        rr = rd * torch.rsqrt(rd * rd * ss / 1280.0 + eps)
+        q.copy_((q.float() * rr[:, None, None]).to(q.dtype))
+        return q
