+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# mypy: ignore-errors
+# ruff: noqa: E501  (one asm instruction or template line per source line)
+"""FFN router and shared gate_up and their finish (P3), as separate
+launches. M ≤ 256.
+
+- ``source_router``: logits partials rpart [M, 32, 384] f32 over 32 K slices
+  of 160. CTA b: slice s = b % 32, expert group g = b / 32 (48 experts = 3
+  tiles of 16). Every wave holds the group's slice of gate as A operands of
+  ``v_mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16`` (lane l: row l % 16, K 8 (l / 16) .. + 7) and
+  computes token tiles w, w + 4, w + 8, w + 12 with B = y (same lane layout).
+  D lane l: token l % 16, experts 4 (l / 16) .. + 3, one dwordx4 store.
+- ``source_shared``: shared gate_up partials gpart [M, 10, 1152] f32 over 10 K
+  slices of 512. CTA b: slice s = b % 10, row group = b / 10 (48 rows = 3
+  tiles). The weight slice sits in AGPRs as fp8 A operands of the scaled
+  16x16x128 F8F6F4 MFMA (lane group q: K 16q .. + 15 in regs 0-3, 64 + 16q ..
+  in regs 4-7; scale of 32-block kb from lane row + 16 kb), B = xq / xs as
+  moe_ug1 reads them.
+- ``source_p3``: one CTA per token.
+  - Router: wave w sums slices 8w .. 8w + 7 (lane l: experts l + 64 j), wave 0
+    sums the 4 in order → logits; score = sqrt(softplus) + bias, 6 argmax
+    rounds (ties to the lower index) → ids; weights = (biased − bias)
+    renormalised × 1.5.
+  - Shared (waves 2-3, thread i < 72: columns 8i .. 8i + 7): sum the 10 slices
+    in order, bf16 (the linear's output), silu(min(g, 10)) · clamp(u, ±10),
+    bf16, MXFP8 (ceil rule, quads share a block) → hq [M, 576], hs [M, 18].
+Tokens ≥ M load 0 and their stores fall outside the buffers.
+
+``source_p3(v3=True)`` (the FFN front without fin): the seam wrote
+y' = bf16(x1 · ffn_norm.w) without the token's rstd. Every wave sums the 160
+Σx1² partials (seam partial value 25) in a fixed order → rstd = rsq(Σ / H +
+norm_eps); the router logits and the shared gate_up sums are scaled by it,
+wave 0 stores rstd[t] (stage 1 scales its g / u by it). A 5th wave runs fin's
+mixes (ffn_seam.mix_wave, KA_MIX's arguments appended with prefix mx_).
+"""
+
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels import ffn_seam
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels.ffn_seam import H, f32
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels.kmod import KArgs, kernel_source, rsrc
+
+E, TOPK, I_SH = 384, 6, 576
+NS = 2 * I_SH  # shared gate|up rows
+RS = 32  # router K slices (160 columns, 5 K steps)
+SS = 10  # shared K slices (512 columns, 4 K tiles)
+R_GRID = RS * (E // 48)  # 256
+S_GRID = SS * (NS // 48)  # 240
+RPART_ROW = RS * E * 4  # bytes of rpart per token
+GPART_ROW = SS * NS * 4  # bytes of gpart per token
+MAX_M = 256
+
+KA_R = KArgs(("gate", "ptr"), ("y", "ptr"), ("part", "ptr"), ("m", "u32"))
+KA_S = KArgs(
+    ("w", "ptr"),
+    ("ws", "ptr"),
+    ("xq", "ptr"),
+    ("xs", "ptr"),
+    ("part", "ptr"),
+    ("m", "u32"),
+)
+KA_3 = KArgs(
+    ("rpart", "ptr"),
+    ("bias", "ptr"),
+    ("logits", "ptr"),
+    ("ids", "ptr"),
+    ("wts", "ptr"),
+    ("gpart", "ptr"),
+    ("hq", "ptr"),
+    ("hs", "ptr"),
+    ("m", "u32"),
+)
+
+
+def source_router(name: str = "ffn_router", w_agpr: bool = False):
+    """w_agpr (router + shared gate_up in one launch): the gate
+    slice in AGPRs a[0:60] (MFMA A operands), 144 VGPRs."""
+    W, Y, D = (
+        16,
+        76,
+        156,
+    )  # gate slice (3 tiles × 5 K steps × 4), y (4 tiles × 5 × 4), D (4 tiles × 3 × 4)
+    if w_agpr:
+        W, Y, D = 0, 16, 96
+    wr = "a" if w_agpr else "v"
+    c = []
+    A = c.append
+    A("  s_load_dwordx8 s[4:11], s[0:1], 0x0")  # gate y part, m s10
+    A("  v_readfirstlane_b32 s12, v0")
+    A("  s_lshr_b32 s12, s12, 6")  # wave
+    A("  v_and_b32 v1, 63, v0")
+    A("  v_and_b32 v2, 15, v1")  # r
+    A("  v_lshrrev_b32 v3, 4, v1")  # lane group q
+    A(f"  s_and_b32 s28, s2, {RS - 1}")  # K slice
+    A("  s_lshr_b32 s29, s2, 5")  # expert group
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s13, s10, {2 * H}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s14, s10, {RPART_ROW}")
+    c += rsrc(16, 4, nbytes=E * 2 * H)
+    c += rsrc(20, 6, nbytes_sgpr=13)
+    c += rsrc(24, 8, nbytes_sgpr=14)
+    A("  s_add_u32 s33, s10, 15")
+    A("  s_lshr_b32 s33, s33, 4")  # token tiles
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s30, s29, {48 * 2 * H}")
+    A("  s_mul_i32 s34, s28, 320")  # slice byte offset
+    A("  s_add_u32 s30, s30, s34")
+    for i in (1, 2):
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s{30 + i}, s{29 + i}, {16 * 2 * H}")  # gate rows of tile i
+    A(f"  v_mul_u32_u24 v4, {2 * H}, v2")
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v4, v3, 4, v4")  # r·2H + 16 q
+    for i in range(3):
+        for k in range(5):
+            r = W + 4 * (5 * i + k)
+            A(
+                f"  buffer_load_dwordx4 {wr}[{r}:{r + 3}], v4, s[16:19], s{30 + i} offen offset:{64 * k}"
+            )
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v15, v3, 4, s34")  # y: 16 q + 320 s
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s35, s28, {E * 4}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s36, s29, {48 * 4}")
+    A("  s_add_u32 s35, s35, s36")
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v14, v3, 4, s35")  # rpart: 16 q + 1536 s + 192 g
+    for j in range(4):
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s36, s12, {4 * j}")
+        A("  s_lshl_b32 s36, s36, 4")
+        A("  v_add_u32 v13, s36, v2")  # t
+        A(f"  v_mul_u32_u24 v{5 + j}, {2 * H}, v13")
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{5 + j}, v{5 + j}, v15")
+        A(f"  v_mul_u32_u24 v{9 + j}, {RPART_ROW}, v13")
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{9 + j}, v{9 + j}, v14")
+    for j in range(4):
+        for k in range(5):
+            r = Y + 20 * j + 4 * k
+            A(
+                f"  buffer_load_dwordx4 v[{r}:{r + 3}], v{5 + j}, s[20:23], 0 offen offset:{64 * k}"
+            )
+    A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+    # token tiles grow with j: the first one past the end ends the work
+    for j in range(4):
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s36, s12, {4 * j}")
+        A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s36, s33")
+        A("  s_cbranch_scc0 .Lmfma_end")
+        for k in range(5):
+            for i in range(3):
+                d, w, y = D + 12 * j + 4 * i, W + 4 * (5 * i + k), Y + 20 * j + 4 * k
+                cin = "0" if k == 0 else f"v[{d}:{d + 3}]"
+                A(
+                    f"  v_mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16 v[{d}:{d + 3}], {wr}[{w}:{w + 3}], v[{y}:{y + 3}], {cin}"
+                )
+    A(".Lmfma_end:")
+    A("  s_nop 7\n  s_nop 7\n  s_nop 7")
+    for j in range(4):
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s36, s12, {4 * j}")
+        A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s36, s33")
+        A("  s_cbranch_scc0 .Lend")
+        for i in range(3):
+            d = D + 12 * j + 4 * i
+            A(
+                f"  buffer_store_dwordx4 v[{d}:{d + 3}], v{9 + j}, s[24:27], 0 offen offset:{64 * i}"
+            )
+    A(".Lend:")
+    A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+    A("  s_endpgm")
+    src = kernel_source(
+        name,
+        c,
+        KA_R,
+        lds=0,
+        vgprs=D + 48,
+        agprs=60 if w_agpr else 0,
+        sgprs=48,
+        block=256,
+    )
+    return dict(name=name, src=src, ka=KA_R)
+
+
+def source_shared(name: str = "ffn_shared_gu", tpr: int = 4):
+    """Tpr: token tiles per round (4: all of a wave's at once; 2: two rounds
+    at M > 128, 132 VGPRs, so a router CTA (w_agpr) fits beside it on a CU)."""
+    assert tpr in (2, 4)
+    SA, XS, X, D = (
+        24,
+        36,
+        52,
+        180,
+    )  # W scales (3 × 4), x scales (4 tiles × 4), xq (4 × 4 × 8), D (4 × 3 × 4)
+    if tpr == 2:
+        XS, X, D = 36, 44, 108  # x scales / xq / D for 2 tiles
+    c = []
+    A = c.append
+    A("  s_load_dwordx8 s[4:11], s[0:1], 0x0")  # w ws xq xs
+    A("  s_load_dwordx4 s[12:15], s[0:1], 0x20")  # part, m s14
+    A("  v_readfirstlane_b32 s16, v0")
+    A("  s_lshr_b32 s16, s16, 6")  # wave
+    A("  v_and_b32 v1, 63, v0")
+    A("  v_and_b32 v2, 15, v1")  # r
+    A("  v_lshrrev_b32 v3, 4, v1")  # lane group q
+    A("  s_mul_hi_u32 s40, s2, 0xcccccccd")
+    A("  s_lshr_b32 s40, s40, 3")  # row group = b / 10
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s41, s40, {SS}")
+    A("  s_sub_u32 s41, s2, s41")  # K slice
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s17, s14, {H}")
+    A("  s_mul_i32 s18, s14, 192")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s19, s14, {GPART_ROW}")
+    c += rsrc(20, 4, nbytes=NS * H)
+    c += rsrc(24, 6, nbytes=NS // 32 * (H // 32))
+    c += rsrc(28, 8, nbytes_sgpr=17)
+    c += rsrc(32, 10, nbytes_sgpr=18)
+    c += rsrc(36, 12, nbytes_sgpr=19)
+    A("  s_add_u32 s42, s14, 15")
+    A("  s_lshr_b32 s42, s42, 4")  # token tiles
+    A("  s_lshl_b32 s50, s41, 9")  # 512 s
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s43, s40, {48 * H}")
+    A("  s_add_u32 s43, s43, s50")
+    for i in (1, 2):
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s{43 + i}, s{42 + i}, {16 * H}")  # weight rows of tile i
+    # weight scale rows: tile i covers rows 16 (3 g + i) .. + 15, all in scale row (3 g + i) / 2
+    A("  s_mul_i32 s60, s40, 3")
+    A("  s_lshl_b32 s61, s41, 4")  # 16 s (4 blocks per K tile × 4 tiles)
+    for i in range(3):
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s{46 + i}, s60, {i}")
+        A(f"  s_lshr_b32 s{46 + i}, s{46 + i}, 1")
+        A(f"  s_mul_i32 s{46 + i}, s{46 + i}, {H // 32}")
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s{46 + i}, s{46 + i}, s61")
+    # xs byte of K tile k0 = 4 s + k in moe_ug1's layout: (k0 / 10)·12 + k0 % 10
+    A("  s_lshl_b32 s62, s41, 2")
+    for k in range(4):
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s63, s62, {k}")
+        A("  s_mul_hi_u32 s64, s63, 0xcccccccd")
+        A("  s_lshr_b32 s64, s64, 3")
+        A("  s_mul_i32 s65, s64, 10")
+        A("  s_sub_u32 s65, s63, s65")
+        A("  s_mul_i32 s64, s64, 12")
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s{51 + k}, s64, s65")
+    A(f"  v_mul_u32_u24 v4, {H}, v2")
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v4, v3, 4, v4")  # r·H + 16 q
+    for i in range(3):
+        for k in range(4):
+            a = 8 * (4 * i + k)
+            A(
+                f"  buffer_load_dwordx4 a[{a}:{a + 3}], v4, s[20:23], s{43 + i} offen offset:{128 * k}"
+            )
+            A(
+                f"  buffer_load_dwordx4 a[{a + 4}:{a + 7}], v4, s[20:23], s{43 + i} offen offset:{128 * k + 64}"
+            )
+            A(
+                f"  buffer_load_ubyte v{SA + 4 * i + k}, v3, s[24:27], s{46 + i} offen offset:{4 * k}"
+            )
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v5, v3, 4, s50")  # xq: 16 q + 512 s
+    A("  v_mul_u32_u24 v6, 48, v3")  # xs: 48 q
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s55, s41, {NS * 4}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s56, s40, {48 * 4}")
+    A("  s_add_u32 s55, s55, s56")
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v7, v3, 4, s55")  # gpart: 16 q + 4608 s + 192 group
+    for j in range(4):
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s56, s16, {4 * j}")
+        A("  s_lshl_b32 s56, s56, 4")
+        A("  v_add_u32 v20, s56, v2")  # t
+        A(f"  v_mul_u32_u24 v{8 + j}, {H}, v20")
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{8 + j}, v{8 + j}, v5")
+        A(f"  v_mul_u32_u24 v{12 + j}, 192, v20")
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{12 + j}, v{12 + j}, v6")
+        A(f"  v_mul_u32_u24 v{16 + j}, {GPART_ROW}, v20")
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{16 + j}, v{16 + j}, v7")
+    for rnd in range(4 // tpr):
+        js = range(rnd * tpr, rnd * tpr + tpr)
+        if rnd:  # the round's first tile past the end ends the work
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s56, s16, {4 * js[0]}")
+            A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s56, s42")
+            A("  s_cbranch_scc0 .Lend")
+        for j in js:
+            for k in range(4):
+                x = X + 32 * (j - js[0]) + 8 * k
+                A(
+                    f"  buffer_load_dwordx4 v[{x}:{x + 3}], v{8 + j}, s[28:31], 0 offen offset:{128 * k}"
+                )
+                A(
+                    f"  buffer_load_dwordx4 v[{x + 4}:{x + 7}], v{8 + j}, s[28:31], 0 offen offset:{128 * k + 64}"
+                )
+                A(
+                    f"  buffer_load_ubyte v{XS + 4 * (j - js[0]) + k}, v{12 + j}, s[32:35], s{51 + k} offen"
+                )
+        A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+        for j in js:
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s56, s16, {4 * j}")
+            A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s56, s42")
+            A(f"  s_cbranch_scc0 .Lmfma_end{rnd if rnd else ''}")
+            for k in range(4):
+                for i in range(3):
+                    d, a, x = (
+                        D + 12 * (j - js[0]) + 4 * i,
+                        8 * (4 * i + k),
+                        X + 32 * (j - js[0]) + 8 * k,
+                    )
+                    cin = "0" if k == 0 else f"v[{d}:{d + 3}]"
+                    A(
+                        f"  v_mfma_scale_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4 v[{d}:{d + 3}], a[{a}:{a + 7}], v[{x}:{x + 7}], {cin}, "
+                        f"v{SA + 4 * i + k}, v{XS + 4 * (j - js[0]) + k} op_sel:[0,0,0] op_sel_hi:[0,0,0] cbsz:0 blgp:0"
+                    )
+        A(f".Lmfma_end{rnd if rnd else ''}:")
+        A("  s_nop 7\n  s_nop 7\n  s_nop 7")
+        for j in js:
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s56, s16, {4 * j}")
+            A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s56, s42")
+            A("  s_cbranch_scc0 .Lend")
+            for i in range(3):
+                d = D + 12 * (j - js[0]) + 4 * i
+                A(
+                    f"  buffer_store_dwordx4 v[{d}:{d + 3}], v{16 + j}, s[36:39], 0 offen offset:{64 * i}"
+                )
+    A(".Lend:")
+    A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+    A("  s_endpgm")
+    src = kernel_source(
+        name, c, KA_S, lds=0, vgprs=D + 12 * tpr, agprs=96, sgprs=72, block=256
+    )
+    return dict(name=name, src=src, ka=KA_S)
+
+
+KA_3V = KArgs(*KA_3.args, *[("mx_" + n, t) for n, t in ffn_seam.KA_MIX.args])
+
+
+def source_p3(name: str | None = None, v3: bool = False):
+    name = name or ("ffn_p3v3" if v3 else "ffn_p3")
+    c = []
+    A = c.append
+    if v3:
+        A("  v_readfirstlane_b32 s21, v0")
+        A("  s_lshr_b32 s21, s21, 6")  # wave
+        A("  s_cmp_eq_u32 s21, 4")
+        A("  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lmxwave")
+    A("  s_load_dwordx16 s[4:19], s[0:1], 0x0")  # rpart bias logits ids wts gpart hq hs
+    A("  s_load_dword s20, s[0:1], 0x40")  # m
+    if not v3:
+        A("  v_readfirstlane_b32 s21, v0")
+        A("  s_lshr_b32 s21, s21, 6")  # wave
+    if v3:
+        A(f"  s_load_dwordx2 s[96:97], s[0:1], {KA_3V.off['mx_partial']:#x}")
+        A(f"  s_load_dwordx2 s[98:99], s[0:1], {KA_3V.off['mx_rstd']:#x}")
+        A(f"  s_load_dword s100, s[0:1], {KA_3V.off['mx_norm_eps']:#x}")
+    A("  v_and_b32 v1, 63, v0")  # lane
+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v2, 2, v1")  # 4 lane
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    if v3:  # Σx1² partials of token t: value 25 of slices lane, lane + 64, lane + 128 (< 160)
+        A("  v_mov_b32 v14, 0")
+        A(f"  s_mul_i32 s101, s2, {ffn_seam.SLICES * 128}")
+        A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v15, 7, v1")
+        A("  v_add_u32 v15, s101, v15")
+        A("  global_load_dword v12, v15, s[96:97] offset:100")
+        A("  v_add_u32 v15, 0x2000, v15")
+        A("  global_load_dword v13, v15, s[96:97] offset:100")
+        A("  v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc, 32, v1")
+        A("  s_and_saveexec_b64 s[22:23], vcc")
+        A("  v_add_u32 v15, 0x2000, v15")
+        A("  global_load_dword v14, v15, s[96:97] offset:100")
+        A("  s_mov_b64 exec, s[22:23]")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s22, s20, {RPART_ROW}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s23, s20, {E * 4}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s56, s20, {TOPK * 4}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s57, s20, {GPART_ROW}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s58, s20, {I_SH}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s59, s20, {I_SH // 32}")
+    c += rsrc(24, 4, nbytes_sgpr=22)  # rpart
+    c += rsrc(28, 6, nbytes=E * 4)  # bias
+    c += rsrc(32, 8, nbytes_sgpr=23)  # logits
+    c += rsrc(36, 10, nbytes_sgpr=56)  # ids
+    c += rsrc(40, 12, nbytes_sgpr=56)  # wts
+    c += rsrc(44, 14, nbytes_sgpr=57)  # gpart
+    c += rsrc(48, 16, nbytes_sgpr=58)  # hq
+    c += rsrc(52, 18, nbytes_sgpr=59)  # hs
+    # per-token offsets
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s60, s2, {RPART_ROW}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s61, s21, {8 * E * 4}")
+    A("  s_add_u32 s60, s60, s61")  # rpart: t, slices 8w ..
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s61, s2, {E * 4}")  # logits
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s62, s2, {TOPK * 4}")  # ids / wts
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s63, s2, {GPART_ROW}")  # gpart
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s64, s2, {I_SH}")  # hq
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s65, s2, {I_SH // 32}")  # hs
+    # ---- router: this wave's 8 slices, experts l + 64 j
+    for sl in range(8):
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{3 + sl}, {sl * E * 4}, v2")
+    for sl in range(8):
+        for j in range(6):
+            A(
+                f"  buffer_load_dword v{16 + 6 * sl + j}, v{3 + sl}, s[24:27], s60 offen offset:{256 * j}"
+            )
+    A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+    for sl in range(1, 8):
+        for j in range(6):
+            A(f"  v_add_f32 v{16 + j}, v{16 + j}, v{16 + 6 * sl + j}")
+    if (
+        v3
+    ):  # Σ over the wave, the same order in every wave → rstd in s101 (lane 0's sum)
+        A("  v_add_f32 v12, v12, v13")
+        A("  v_add_f32 v12, v12, v14")
+        for ctl in ("row_ror:8", "row_ror:4", "row_ror:2", "row_ror:1"):
+            A("  s_nop 1")
+            A(f"  v_add_f32_dpp v12, v12, v12 {ctl} row_mask:0xf bank_mask:0xf")
+        for sw in ("v_permlane16_swap_b32", "v_permlane32_swap_b32"):
+            A("  v_mov_b32 v13, v12")
+            A("  s_nop 1")
+            A(f"  {sw} v12, v13")
+            A("  s_nop 3")
+            A("  v_add_f32 v12, v12, v13")
+        A("  v_mov_b32 v13, s100")
+        A(
+            f"  s_mov_b32 s22, {f32(1.0 / H)}"
+        )  # (s22's rpart size is in the descriptor already)
+        A("  v_fma_f32 v12, v12, s22, v13")
+        A("  v_rsq_f32 v12, v12")
+        A("  s_nop 1")

+def fn_hl(fn):
+    """Hc fn [24, 4H] f32 → v2's B operands, bf16 hi = bf16(fn) and lo =
+    bf16(fn − hi) as v1 computes them per task, in fragment order:
+    [slice cs][q = 2·stream + n-block][hi, lo][lane l][8 bf16]: row l % 16 + 16 nb
+    (rows ≥ 24 zero), columns 32 cs + 8 (l / 16) .. + 7 of stream q / 2."""
+    import torch
+
+    f = torch.zeros(32, 4 * H, dtype=torch.float32, device=fn.device)
+    f[: fn.shape[0]] = fn.float()
+    hi = f.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    lo = (f - hi.float()).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    out = []
+    for t in (hi, lo):
+        # [nb, r, stream j, cs, g, 8] → [cs, j, nb, (g, r), 8]
+        v = (
+            t.view(2, 16, 4, SLICES, 4, 8)
+            .permute(3, 2, 0, 4, 1, 5)
+            .reshape(SLICES, 4, 2, 64, 8)
+        )
+        out.append(v)
+    return (
+        torch.stack(out, 3).reshape(SLICES, 8, 2, 64, 8).contiguous().view(torch.int32)
+    )

+    return min((m + 15) // 16, 6)

+    A("  v_rcp_f32 v38, v38")
+    A("  s_nop 0")
+    A("  v_add_f32 v39, s28, v38")  # pre' = σ + hc_eps
+    A("  v_mul_f32 v40, s29, v38")  # post' = σ · alpha
+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v41, 2, v1")
+    A(f"  v_mov_b32 v42, {tok}")
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v41, v42, 4, v41")  # t·16 + 4 L
+    A("  v_subrev_u32 v46, 16, v41")  # post offset, before exec narrows to lanes 0..3
+    A("  s_mov_b64 exec, 0xf")
+    A("  buffer_store_dword v39, v41, s[56:59], 0 offen")
+    A("  s_mov_b64 exec, 0xf0")
+    A("  buffer_store_dword v40, v46, s[48:51], 0 offen")
+    A("  s_mov_b64 exec, -1")
+
+    # Sinkhorn on lanes 16..31 (row r = (L−16)/4, column c = L%4)
+    def dpp(op, d, a, b, ctl):
+        A("  s_nop 1")
+        A(f"  v_{op}_f32_dpp v{d}, v{a}, v{b} {ctl} row_mask:0xf bank_mask:0xf")
+
+    QA, QB, R4, R8 = (
+        "quad_perm:[1,0,3,2]",
+        "quad_perm:[2,3,0,1]",
+        "row_ror:4",
+        "row_ror:8",
+    )
+
+    def rownorm(p, first=False):
+        dpp("add", 44, p, p, QA)
+        dpp("add", 44, 44, 44, QB)
+        if not first:
+            A("  v_add_f32 v44, s28, v44")
+        A("  v_rcp_f32 v44, v44")
+        A("  s_nop 0")
+        A(f"  v_mul_f32 v{p}, v{p}, v44")
+        if first:
+            A(f"  v_add_f32 v{p}, s28, v{p}")
+
+    def colnorm(p):
+        dpp("add", 44, p, p, R4)
+        dpp("add", 44, 44, 44, R8)
+        A("  v_add_f32 v44, s28, v44")
+        A("  v_rcp_f32 v44, v44")
+        A("  s_nop 0")
+        A(f"  v_mul_f32 v{p}, v{p}, v44")
+
+    dpp("max", 43, 37, 37, QA)
+    dpp("max", 43, 43, 43, QB)
+    A("  v_sub_f32 v45, v37, v43")
+    A("  v_mul_f32 v45, s88, v45")
+    A("  v_exp_f32 v45, v45")
+    A("  s_nop 0")

+    colnorm(45)
+    for _ in range(SINKHORN - 1):
+        rownorm(45)
+        colnorm(45)
+    A("  v_subrev_u32 v46, 16, v1")
+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v46, 2, v46")
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v46, v42, 6, v46")  # t·64 + 4 (L − 16)
+    A(
+        "  s_mov_b32 exec_lo, 0xffff0000"
+    )  # lanes 16..31 only (a b64 literal would sign-extend)
+    A("  s_mov_b32 exec_hi, 0")
+    A("  buffer_store_dword v45, v46, s[52:55], 0 offen")
+    A("  s_mov_b64 exec, -1")
+

+# the mixes wave: fin's partial sums, gates and Sinkhorn for one token at a time, as a spare
+# wave of another kernel (gemv8.source(mix_wave=True), kernargs appended with prefix mx_)
+KA_MIX = KArgs(
+    ("partial", "ptr"),
+    ("scale", "ptr"),
+    ("base", "ptr"),
+    ("post_out", "ptr"),
+    ("comb_out", "ptr"),
+    ("pre_out", "ptr"),
+    ("rstd", "ptr"),
+    ("m", "u32"),
+    ("rms_eps", "u32"),
+    ("hc_eps", "u32"),
+    ("post_alpha", "u32"),
+    ("norm_eps", "u32"),
+    ("dbg", "ptr"),
+)
+MIX_LDS = 128
+MIX_TL = [
+    "start",
+    "kernarg",
+    "loaded",
+    "summed",
+    "end",
+]  # knock "stamps": s_memrealtime → dbg[t·8 + k] (u32)

+def mix_wave(
+    ka_base: int,
+    stride: int,
+    lds: int,
+    knock: str = "",
+    first: str = "s2",
+    slot: str = "",
+    bar_m: str = "",
+    nbar: int = 0,
+    rstd_store: bool = True,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """One wave doing fin's work except y: tokens t = ``first`` (an SGPR set by
+    the caller, e.g. workgroup id + grid · spare-wave index), + stride, .. < m.
+    The 160 partial rows of t in 20 contiguous 1 KB loads, all in flight at
+    once (lane l: row 8k + l / 8, floats 4 (l % 8) ..), summed per lane in k
+    order, then over the 8 row groups (row_ror 8, permlane 16 / 32 swaps);
+    lanes 0..7 → LDS (MIX_LDS bytes at ``lds`` + SGPR ``slot``) → lane L reads value v(L) as
+    fin's wave 0, then ``gates_sinkhorn`` → pre / post / comb, and rstd_n =
+    rsq(Σx1² / H + norm_eps) → rstd[t] (f32). Not bitwise = fin (summation
+    order). KA_MIX's arguments at kernarg offset ka_base. Uses v0..v134,
+    s0..s91 (``first``, ``slot`` and ``bar_m`` are read before s4). bar_m: the
+    host kernel's barriers (s_barrier waits for every live wave of the
+    workgroup, so a spare wave that skips them holds the others at their first
+    one until it ends): with its loads in flight, the wave steps through
+    2·⌈m / 64⌉ + 2 barriers (gemv8 mode k with split-K; m in SGPR bar_m), then
+    sums and runs the gates while the last arrivers reduce. nbar: instead, a fixed
+    number of host barriers to step through (e.g. p3's one). rstd_store False:
+    rstd[t] is the host's to write (K2 v3's p3). knock (timing only): "exit" the
+    wave ends at once, "sums" no gates / Sinkhorn, "one" only the first
+    token, "sleep<ns>" / "spin<ns>" idle / VALU-busy that long, "stamps"
+    s_memrealtime at MIX_TL's points → dbg (first token only)."""
+    c = []
+    A = c.append
+    if knock == "exit":
+        return ["  s_endpgm"]
+    if knock.startswith("sleep"):
+        return [
+            "  s_memrealtime s[4:5]",
+            "  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)",
+            f"  s_add_u32 s4, s4, {int(knock[5:]) // 10}",
+            ".Lmx_sleep:",
+            "  s_sleep 1",
+            "  s_memrealtime s[6:7]",
+            "  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)",
+            "  s_cmp_lt_u32 s6, s4",
+            "  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lmx_sleep",
+            "  s_endpgm",
+        ]
+    if knock.startswith(
+        "spin"
+    ):  # "spin<ns>": dependent VALU (v_rcp chains) that long, then end
+        return (
+            [
+                "  s_memrealtime s[4:5]",
+                "  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)",
+                f"  s_add_u32 s4, s4, {int(knock[4:]) // 10}",
+                "  v_mov_b32 v1, 1.0",
+                ".Lmx_spin:",
+            ]
+            + ["  v_rcp_f32 v1, v1", "  v_add_f32 v1, 1.0, v1"] * 32
+            + [
+                "  s_memrealtime s[6:7]",
+                "  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)",
+                "  s_cmp_lt_u32 s6, s4",
+                "  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lmx_spin",
+                "  s_endpgm",
+            ]

+    LB, ACC, T = 50, 130, 134
+    stamps = knock == "stamps"
+
+    def stamp(k):
+        if stamps:
+            A(
+                f"  s_memrealtime s[{92 + 2 * k}:{93 + 2 * k}]"
+                if k < 4
+                else "  s_memrealtime s[84:85]"
+            )
+
+    stamp(0)
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s90, {first}")  # t
+    A(
+        f"  s_load_dwordx16 s[4:19], s[0:1], {ka_base:#x}"
+    )  # partial scale base post comb pre rstd, m s18
+    A(
+        f"  s_load_dwordx4 s[20:23], s[0:1], {ka_base + 0x40:#x}"
+    )  # hc_eps s20, alpha s21, norm_eps s22
+    A("  v_and_b32 v1, 63, v0")  # lane
+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v5, 4, v1")  # 16 l: load offset, LDS write offset (lanes < 8)
+    A(f"  v_mov_b32 v8, {slot or 0}")  # the wave's LDS slot
+    A("  v_add_u32 v10, v5, v8")
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    stamp(1)
+    A("  s_cmp_ge_u32 s90, s18")
+    A("  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lmx_end")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s77, s18, {SLICES * 128}")
+    c.extend(rsrc(32, 4, nbytes_sgpr=77))  # partial
+    c.extend(rsrc(44, 8, nbytes=24 * 4))  # base

+    A("  v_and_b32 v3, 31, v1")
+    A("  v_add_u32 v4, 16, v3")
+    A("  v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc, 8, v3")
+    A("  v_cndmask_b32 v4, v4, v3, vcc")
+    A("  v_subrev_u32 v6, 8, v3")
+    A("  v_cmp_le_u32 vcc, 16, v3")
+    A("  v_cndmask_b32 v4, v4, v6, vcc")  # v(j)
+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v7, 2, v4")
+    A(
+        "  buffer_load_dword v34, v7, s[44:47], 0 offen"
+    )  # base[v] (0 past 24), for every token
+
+    def loads():
+        A(f"  s_mul_i32 s81, s90, {SLICES * 128}")
+        for k in range(20):
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s82, s81, {1024 * k}")
+            A(
+                f"  buffer_load_dwordx4 v[{LB + 4 * k}:{LB + 4 * k + 3}], v5, s[32:35], s82 offen"
+            )
+
+    loads()
+    A("  s_mov_b32 s27, s19")  # rms_eps
+    A("  s_mov_b32 s28, s20")  # hc_eps
+    A("  s_mov_b32 s29, s21")  # alpha
+    A("  s_mov_b32 s30, s22")  # norm_eps
+    A("  s_load_dwordx2 s[72:73], s[6:7], 0x0")  # scale[0:2]
+    A("  s_load_dword s74, s[6:7], 0x8")
+    A("  s_lshl_b32 s79, s18, 4")
+    A("  s_lshl_b32 s80, s18, 6")
+    A("  s_lshl_b32 s78, s18, 2")
+    c.extend(rsrc(48, 10, nbytes_sgpr=79))  # post_out
+    c.extend(rsrc(52, 12, nbytes_sgpr=80))  # comb_out
+    c.extend(rsrc(56, 14, nbytes_sgpr=79))  # pre_out
+    c.extend(rsrc(60, 16, nbytes_sgpr=78))  # rstd
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s86, {f32(1.0 / (4 * H))}")
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s87, {f32(1.0 / H)}")
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s88, {f32(1.4426950408889634)}")  # log2 e
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s89, {f32(-1.4426950408889634)}")
+    A("  v_add_u32 v11, v7, v8")
+    A("  v_mov_b32 v12, 0")
+    if bar_m:
+        A(f"  s_add_u32 s83, {bar_m}, 63")
+        A("  s_lshr_b32 s83, s83, 6")
+        A("  s_lshl_b32 s83, s83, 1")
+        A("  s_add_u32 s83, s83, 2")

+        A("  s_sub_u32 s83, s83, 1")
+        A("  s_cmp_lg_u32 s83, 0")
+        A("  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lmx_bar")
+    for _ in range(nbar):
+        A("  s_barrier")
+    A(".Lmx_tok:")
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    for k in range(20):
+        # sum as the loads land (in order; later tokens: their loads landed in gates_sinkhorn's
+        # wait, only its stores may be outstanding, so the count is conservative)
+        A(f"  s_waitcnt vmcnt({19 - k})")
+        if k == 19:
+            stamp(2)
+        for i in range(4):
+            if k == 0:
+                A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{ACC + i}, v{LB + i}")
+            else:
+                A(f"  v_add_f32 v{ACC + i}, v{ACC + i}, v{LB + 4 * k + i}")
+    for i in range(4):
+        x = ACC + i
+        A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{T}, v{x}")
+        A("  s_nop 1")
+        A(f"  v_add_f32_dpp v{x}, v{T}, v{x} row_ror:8 row_mask:0xf bank_mask:0xf")
+        for sw in ("v_permlane16_swap_b32", "v_permlane32_swap_b32"):
+            A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{T}, v{x}")
+            A("  s_nop 1")
+            A(f"  {sw} v{x}, v{T}")
+            A("  s_nop 3")
+            A(f"  v_add_f32 v{x}, v{x}, v{T}")

+    A(f"  ds_write_b128 v10, v[{ACC}:{ACC + 3}] offset:{lds}")
+    A("  s_mov_b64 exec, -1")
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    A(f"  ds_read_b32 v31, v11 offset:{lds}")
+    A(f"  ds_read_b32 v32, v8 offset:{lds + 96}")  # Σ R'²
+    A(f"  ds_read_b32 v33, v8 offset:{lds + 100}")  # Σ x1²
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    stamp(3)
+    A("  s_mov_b32 s91, s90")  # this token; s90 → the next one, its loads in flight
+    A(f"  s_add_u32 s90, s90, {stride}")
+    A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s90, s18")
+    A("  s_cbranch_scc0 .Lmx_last")

+    A(".Lmx_last:")
+    A("  v_mov_b32 v9, s30")
+    A("  v_fma_f32 v33, v33, s87, v9")
+    A("  v_rsq_f32 v33, v33")  # rstd_n
+    if rstd_store:
+        A("  s_lshl_b32 s82, s91, 2")
+        A("  s_mov_b64 exec, 1")
+        A("  buffer_store_dword v33, v12, s[60:63], s82 offen")
+        A("  s_mov_b64 exec, -1")

+        gates_sinkhorn(A, tok="s91", base_loaded=True)
+    if knock in ("one", "stamps"):
+        if stamps:  # 4 stamps in s92..s99 (lo/hi pairs), the end in s84
+            stamp(4)
+            A(f"  s_load_dwordx2 s[26:27], s[0:1], {ka_base + KA_MIX.off['dbg']:#x}")
+            A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+            A("  s_lshl_b32 s82, s91, 5")
+            A("  s_add_u32 s26, s26, s82")
+            A("  s_addc_u32 s27, s27, 0")
+            A("  v_mov_b32 v12, 0")

+        A("  s_endpgm")
+    A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s90, s18")
+    A("  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lmx_tok")
+    A(".Lmx_end:")
+    A("  s_endpgm")

+def source_fin(name: str = "ffn_seam_fin", frag: bool = False):
+    """FFN seam, second pass (aiter's reduce kernel + the mixes): one CTA per
+    token t.
+    1. Sum the 160 partial rows in fixed order: thread (rg = tid/32, j = tid%32)
+       sums rows 20 rg .. 20 rg + 19 of value v(j), then threads 0..31 sum the
+       8 groups. v(j) puts pre/post on lanes 0..7, Σ R'² / Σ x1² on 8..9 and
+       the 16 comb logits on lanes 16..31 (one DPP row: row sums are quads,
+       column sums row_ror 4 + 8).
+    2. Wave 0: rstd, pre' / post' gates, comb' by Sinkhorn (softmax, then
+       20 × row / column normalise, x / s as x · rcp(s) like aiter's
+       fast_dividef) → pre_out, post_out, comb_out.
+    3. Threads 0..159, one 32-column block each: y = bf16((x1 · rstd_n) · w)
+       → y [M, H] (the router's input), then MXFP8 of y → xq, xs."""
+    c = []
+    A = c.append
+    A(
+        "  s_load_dwordx16 s[4:19], s[0:1], 0x0"
+    )  # partial x1 norm_w scale base post comb pre
+    A("  s_load_dwordx8 s[20:27], s[0:1], 0x40")  # y xq xs, m s26, rms_eps s27
+    A("  s_load_dwordx4 s[28:31], s[0:1], 0x60")  # hc_eps s28, alpha s29, norm_eps s30
+    A("  v_readfirstlane_b32 s76, v0")
+    A("  s_lshr_b32 s76, s76, 6")  # wave
+    A("  v_and_b32 v1, 63, v0")  # lane
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    A("  s_load_dwordx2 s[72:73], s[10:11], 0x0")  # scale[0:2]
+    A("  s_load_dword s74, s[10:11], 0x8")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s77, s26, {SLICES * 128}")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s78, s26, {2 * H}")
+    A("  s_lshl_b32 s79, s26, 4")
+    A("  s_lshl_b32 s80, s26, 6")

+        A(f"  s_mov_b32 s82, {256 * H // 32}")
+    else:

+        A("  s_mul_i32 s82, s26, 192")

+    c += rsrc(36, 6, nbytes_sgpr=78)  # x1
+    c += rsrc(40, 8, nbytes=2 * H)  # norm_w
+    c += rsrc(44, 12, nbytes=24 * 4)  # base
+    c += rsrc(48, 14, nbytes_sgpr=79)  # post_out
+    c += rsrc(52, 16, nbytes_sgpr=80)  # comb_out
+    c += rsrc(56, 18, nbytes_sgpr=79)  # pre_out
+    c += rsrc(60, 20, nbytes_sgpr=78)  # y
+    c += rsrc(64, 22, nbytes_sgpr=81)  # xq
+    c += rsrc(68, 24, nbytes_sgpr=82)  # xs
+    # ---- 1. partial sums. v(j) = j (j < 8), j + 16 (8 ≤ j < 16), j − 8 (16 ≤ j < 32)
+    A("  v_lshrrev_b32 v2, 5, v0")  # rg
+    A("  v_and_b32 v3, 31, v0")  # j
+    A("  v_add_u32 v4, 16, v3")
+    A("  v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc, 8, v3")
+    A("  v_cndmask_b32 v4, v4, v3, vcc")
+    A("  v_subrev_u32 v5, 8, v3")
+    A("  v_cmp_le_u32 vcc, 16, v3")
+    A("  v_cndmask_b32 v4, v4, v5, vcc")  # v(j)
+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v7, 2, v4")
+    A(f"  s_mul_i32 s83, s2, {SLICES}")
+    A("  v_mad_u32_u24 v5, 20, v2, s83")
+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v5, 7, v5")
+    A("  v_lshl_add_u32 v5, v4, 2, v5")
+    for k in range(20):
+        A(f"  buffer_load_dword v{10 + k}, v5, s[32:35], 0 offen offset:{128 * k}")

+    A("  v_mov_b32 v30, v10")
+    for k in range(1, 20):

+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v6, 2, v0")
+    A("  ds_write_b32 v6, v30")
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    A("  s_barrier")
+    A("  v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc, 32, v0")

+    for g in range(8):
+        A(f"  ds_read_b32 v{10 + g}, v6 offset:{128 * g}")

+    A("  v_mov_b32 v31, v10")
+    for g in range(1, 8):

+    A("  s_mov_b64 exec, s[84:85]")
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    A("  s_barrier")
+    A("  v_mov_b32 v8, 0")
+    A("  ds_read_b32 v32, v8 offset:1120")
+    A("  ds_read_b32 v33, v8 offset:1124")  # Σ x1² (value 25)
+    A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s86, {f32(1.0 / (4 * H))}")
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s87, {f32(1.0 / H)}")
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s88, {f32(1.4426950408889634)}")  # log2 e
+    A(f"  s_mov_b32 s89, {f32(-1.4426950408889634)}")
+    A("  v_mov_b32 v9, s30")
+    A("  v_fma_f32 v33, v33, s87, v9")
+    A("  v_rsq_f32 v33, v33")  # rstd_n (every wave)
+    A("  s_cmp_eq_u32 s76, 0")
+    A("  s_cbranch_scc0 .Lnorm")

+            part_base("s28")
+            for i in range(TI):
+                if i == 4:
+                    A("  s_add_u32 s42, s42, 4096")
+                    A("  s_addc_u32 s43, s43, 0")
+                A(
+                    f"  global_store_dwordx4 v{V_T}, v[{SUM + 4 * i}:{SUM + 4 * i + 3}], s[42:43] offset:{1024 * (i % 4)}"
+                )
+        elif P.get("epi_fn"):
+            P["epi_fn"](
+                dict(
+                    A=A,
+                    SUM=SUM,
+                    V_E=V_E,
+                    V_L=V_L,
+                    V_R=V_R,
+                    V_Q=V_Q,
+                    V_T=V_T,
+                    label=label,
+                    nop=nop,
+                )
+            )
+        else:
+            epilogue()
+
+    NT = MAXJ // 4
+    PDn = NB - 1
+    if mode == "t":
+        # ---- weights LDS → AGPRs, then token tiles w + 4 n over all K, x prefetched NB - 1 ahead
+        def x_load_n(n):
+            """Token tile min(w + 4 n, TT - 1) → XBUF[n % NB] (always issued: static vmcnt counts)."""
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s44, s26, {4 * n}")
+            A("  s_sub_u32 s45, s29, 1")
+            A("  s_min_u32 s44, s44, s45")
+            x_load(n % NB)
+
+        A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+        A("  s_barrier")
+        stamp(2)
+        rb_ = V_T
+        if lb:  # offsets are 16-bit: the base goes into a VGPR
+            rb_ = V_T + 1
+            A(f"  v_add_u32 v{rb_}, {lb}, v{V_T}")
+        for i in range(TI):
+            for k in range(KT):
+                a = ab + 8 * (KT * i + k)
+                for h in range(2):
+                    off = ((KT * i + k) * 2 + h) * 1024
+                    A(
+                        f"  ds_read_b128 a[{a + 4 * h}:{a + 4 * h + 3}], v{rb_} offset:{off}"
+                    )
+        for n in range(min(PDn, NT)):
+            x_load_n(n)
+        A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+        stamp(3)
+        for n in range(NT):
+            if n + PDn < NT:
+                x_load_n(n + PDn)
+            ahead = min(PDn, NT - 1 - n)
+            A(f"  s_waitcnt vmcnt({3 * KT * ahead})")
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s45, s26, {4 * n}")
+            A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s45, s29")
+            A(f"  s_cbranch_scc0 .L{pf}main_done")
+            mfma(n % NB)
+            nop(20)
+            finish_tile()
+            if n == 0:
+                stamp(4)
+    else:
+        # ---- every token tile over the wave's K tiles; batches of 4 meet in LDS
+        def x_load_n(n):
+            A("  s_sub_u32 s44, s29, 1")
+            A(f"  s_min_u32 s44, s44, {n}")
+            x_load(n % NB)
+
+        A(f"  s_mul_i32 s48, s26, {4 * SLOT}")
+        if lb:
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s48, s48, {lb}")
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{V_T + 1}, s48, v{V_T}")  # write base lb + (4 w)·SLOT + 16 l
+        A(f"  s_mul_i32 s48, s26, {SLOT}")
+        if lb:
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s48, s48, {lb}")
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{V_T + 2}, s48, v{V_T}")  # read base for jj = w
+        A(f"  v_add_u32 v{V_T + 3}, {8 * SLOT}, v{V_T + 2}")  # waves 2, 3
+        for n in range(PDn):
+            x_load_n(n)
+        stamp(2)
+        stamp(3)
+        for b in range(MAXJ // 4):
+            A(f"  s_cmp_le_u32 s29, {4 * b}")
+            A(f"  s_cbranch_scc1 .L{pf}main_done")
+            for jj in range(4):
+                n = 4 * b + jj
+                zero = label("zero")
+                if n + PDn < MAXJ:
+                    x_load_n(n + PDn)
+                ahead = min(PDn, MAXJ - 1 - n)
+                # the previous batch's epilogue ops are younger than tile n's loads for jj < PDn (if a batch
+                # runs, every wave finished a tile in the one before)
+                ev = P.get("epi_vm", 0) if b and jj < PDn else 0
+                A(f"  s_waitcnt vmcnt({3 * KW * ahead + ev})")
+                A(f"  s_cmp_le_u32 s29, {n}")
+                A(f"  s_cbranch_scc1 {zero}")
+                mfma(n % NB)
+                nop(20)
+                for i in range(TI):
+                    d = D0 + 4 * i
+                    A(
+                        f"  ds_write_b128 v{V_T + 1}, v[{d}:{d + 3}] offset:{jj * SLOT + 1024 * i}"
+                    )
+                A(f"{zero}:")
+            A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+            A("  s_barrier")
+            fin = label("fin")
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s45, s26, {4 * b}")
+            A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s45, s29")
+            A(f"  s_cbranch_scc0 {fin}")
+            for wv in range(4):  # sum in wave order
+                base, off = (
+                    (V_T + 2, 4 * SLOT * wv)
+                    if wv < 2
+                    else (V_T + 3, 4 * SLOT * (wv - 2))
+                )
+                dst = SUM if wv == 0 else STG
+                for i in range(TI):
+                    A(
+                        f"  ds_read_b128 v[{dst + 4 * i}:{dst + 4 * i + 3}], v{base} offset:{off + 1024 * i}"
+                    )
+                A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+                if wv:
+                    for i in range(TI):
+                        for k in range(4):
+                            A(
+                                f"  v_add_f32 v{SUM + 4 * i + k}, v{SUM + 4 * i + k}, v{STG + 4 * i + k}"
+                            )
+            finish_tile()
+            if b == 0:
+                stamp(4)
+            A(f"{fin}:")
+            A("  s_barrier")  # LDS slots free again
+    A(f".L{pf}main_done:")
+    stamp(5)
+    if S > 1:
+        # red "wait": all S slices of the row group must be co-resident: arrive on a monotonic counter,
+        # wait for the other slices, then slice s reduces token tiles j ≡ s (mod S): wave w takes
+        # j = s + S·(w + 4u). That deadlocks when other streams' CTAs hold the CUs a slice needs.
+        # red "last": no waiting; the last arriver reduces every tile.
+        red = P.get("red", RED)
+        assert red in ("wait", "last"), red
+        A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+        A("  s_barrier")
+        A("  s_cmp_eq_u32 s26, 0")
+        A(f"  s_cbranch_scc0 .L{pf}ticket_wait")
+        A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{V_E}, 1")
+        A("  s_lshl_b32 s40, s27, 2")
+        A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{V_E + 1}, s40")
+        A("  s_mov_b64 exec, 1")
+        A(f"  global_atomic_add v{V_E + 2}, v{V_E + 1}, v{V_E}, s[18:19] sc0 sc1")
+        A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+        A(f"  v_readfirstlane_b32 s40, v{V_E + 2}")
+        if red == "last":
+            # the group's last arriver (old count ≡ S − 1 mod S; the counter is monotonic) reduces; LDS tells the waves
+            A(f"  s_and_b32 s40, s40, {S - 1}")
+            A(f"  s_cmp_eq_u32 s40, {S - 1}")
+            A("  s_cselect_b32 s40, 1, 0")
+            A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{V_E + 2}, s40")
+            A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{V_E + 1}, {TICKET}")
+            A(f"  ds_write_b32 v{V_E + 1}, v{V_E + 2}")
+            A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+        else:
+            A(f"  s_lshr_b32 s40, s40, {S.bit_length() - 1}")
+            A("  s_add_u32 s40, s40, 1")
+            A(
+                f"  s_lshl_b32 s40, s40, {S.bit_length() - 1}"
+            )  # this launch's target count
+            A(f".L{pf}poll:")
+            A(f"  global_load_dword v{V_E + 2}, v{V_E + 1}, s[18:19] sc1")
+            A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+            A(f"  v_readfirstlane_b32 s41, v{V_E + 2}")
+            A("  s_sub_u32 s41, s41, s40")  # wrap-safe: count - target ≥ 0
+            A("  s_cmp_lt_i32 s41, 0")
+            A(f"  s_cbranch_scc0 .L{pf}polled")
+            A("  s_sleep 1")
+            A(f"  s_branch .L{pf}poll")
+            A(f".L{pf}polled:")
+        A("  s_mov_b64 exec, -1")
+        A(f".L{pf}ticket_wait:")
+        A("  s_barrier")
+        if red == "last":
+            A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{V_E + 1}, {TICKET}")
+            A(f"  ds_read_b32 v{V_E + 2}, v{V_E + 1}")
+            A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+            A(f"  v_readfirstlane_b32 s40, v{V_E + 2}")
+            A("  s_cmp_eq_u32 s40, 0")
+            A(f"  s_cbranch_scc1 {end}")
+            A("  s_mov_b32 s28, 0")  # every token tile: as slice 0 of a 1-slice split
+        stamp(6)
+        SR = 1 if red == "last" else S  # slices sharing the token tiles
+        items = [(u, ch) for u in range(MAXJ // (4 * SR) or 1) for ch in range(S // SC)]
+
+        def tile_of(u):
+            """s45 = s + SR·(w + 4u)."""
+            A(f"  s_add_u32 s45, s26, {4 * u}")
+            if SR > 1:
+                A(f"  s_lshl_b32 s45, s45, {SR.bit_length() - 1}")
+            A("  s_add_u32 s45, s45, s28")
+
+        def chunk_load(k):
+            u, ch = items[k]
+            buf = PCH[k % 2]
+            tile_of(u)
+            A("  s_sub_u32 s49, s29, 1")
+            A("  s_min_u32 s45, s45, s49")  # clamped (loads past the end stay valid)
+            for sl in range(SC):
+                A(f"  s_mov_b32 s49, {ch * SC + sl}")
+                part_base("s49")
+                for i in range(TI):
+                    if i == 4:
+                        A("  s_add_u32 s42, s42, 4096")
+                        A("  s_addc_u32 s43, s43, 0")
+                    r = buf + 4 * (TI * sl + i)
+                    A(
+                        f"  global_load_dwordx4 v[{r}:{r + 3}], v{V_T}, s[42:43] offset:{1024 * (i % 4)} nt"
+                    )
+
+        chunk_load(0)
+        for k, (u, ch) in enumerate(items):
+            if ch == 0:
+                tile_of(u)
+                A("  s_cmp_lt_u32 s45, s29")
+                A(f"  s_cbranch_scc0 {end}")
+            if k + 1 < len(items):
+                chunk_load(k + 1)
+                A(f"  s_waitcnt vmcnt({SC * TI})")
+            else:
+                A("  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)")
+            buf = PCH[k % 2]
+            for sl in range(SC):
+                for i in range(TI):
+                    for q in range(4):
+                        d, r = SUM + 4 * i + q, buf + 4 * (TI * sl + i) + q
+                        A(
+                            f"  v_mov_b32 v{d}, v{r}"
+                            if ch == 0 and sl == 0
+                            else f"  v_add_f32 v{d}, v{d}, v{r}"
+                        )
+            if ch == S // SC - 1:
+                tile_of(u)
+                epilogue()
+    return dict(vgprs=VGPRS, agprs=AGPRS, lds=LDS, V_E=V_E)
+
+
+def _header(c, timeline):
+    A = c.append
+    A("  s_load_dwordx16 s[4:19], s[0:1], 0x0")  # w ws x xs out outs part cnt
+    A("  s_load_dwordx4 s[20:23], s[0:1], 0x40")  # cs pos
+    A("  s_load_dwordx2 s[50:51], s[0:1], 0x50")  # dbg
+    A("  s_load_dword s24, s[0:1], 0x58")  # m
+    if timeline:
+        A("  s_memrealtime s[52:53]")
+        A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+        A("  s_mov_b32 s60, s52")
+    A("  v_readfirstlane_b32 s26, v0")
+    A("  s_lshr_b32 s26, s26, 6")
+    A("  v_and_b32 v1, 63, v0")
+    A("  v_and_b32 v2, 15, v1")
+    A("  v_lshrrev_b32 v3, 4, v1")
+    A("  v_lshlrev_b32 v4, 4, v1")  # 16 l
+
+
+def _footer(c, timeline, V_E):
+    A = c.append
+    A(".Lstamps:")
+    if timeline:
+        A("  s_memrealtime s[52:53]")
+        A("  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)")
+        A("  s_mov_b32 s67, s52")
+        A("  s_lshl_b32 s40, s2, 2")
+        A("  s_add_u32 s40, s40, s26")
+        A("  s_lshl_b32 s40, s40, 5")
+        A("  s_add_u32 s50, s50, s40")
+        A("  s_addc_u32 s51, s51, 0")
+        A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{V_E}, 0")
+        A("  s_mov_b64 exec, 1")
+        for k in range(len(TL)):
+            A(f"  v_mov_b32 v{V_E + 1}, s{60 + k}")
+            A(f"  global_store_dword v{V_E}, v{V_E + 1}, s[50:51] offset:{4 * k}")
+    A(".Lexit:")
+    A("  s_endpgm")
+
+
+def source(
+    cfg: Cfg,
+    mode: str = "t",
+    knock: frozenset = frozenset(),
+    timeline: bool = False,
+    kv_wave: bool | str = False,
+    mix_wave: bool | str = False,
+    mix_waves: int = 2,
+    mix_bar: bool = True,
+    kv_bar: bool = False,
+    extra: tuple | None = None,
+):
+    """One GEMV kernel (see the module docstring and _emit). kv_wave (wq_b without a qkv_norm launch): a 5th wave per CTA runs
+    qkv_norm's kv path (record + SWA insert) for token = workgroup id, with
+    qkv_norm's arguments appended (KA_KV, prefixed kv_); "rstd" (step 1b):
+    kv comes in without the attention norm's rstd, which the wave reads from
+    kv_rstd[t] (KA_KVR). mix_wave (step 1b): a 5th wave runs the seam fin's
+    mixes (ffn_seam.mix_wave; KA_MX, prefixed mx_; a string: mix_wave's knock) in mix_waves extra waves:
+    wave 4 + i takes tokens b + grid·i, + grid·mix_waves, .. (one each up to M = grid·mix_waves); mix_bar:
+    they step through the GEMV's barriers before their math (mode k, split-K). kv_bar: the kv wave loads
+    everything first and steps through the GEMV's barriers (mode k, S = 1; qkv_norm bar_m).
+    extra = (cfg2, mode2) (wq_b + the indexer's wq_b in one launch): CTAs cfg.grid ..
+    cfg.grid + cfg2.grid − 1 run cfg2's GEMV on the same x / xs / pos / m with their own w / ws / out / outs /
+    part / cnt / cs (KArgs appended, prefixed x2_; KA_X2 below); their extra waves (kv / mix) end at once."""
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels import ffn_seam, qkv_norm
+
+    assert not (kv_wave and mix_wave)
+    c = []
+    if extra:
+        c += [f"  s_cmp_ge_u32 s2, {cfg.grid}", "  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lx2"]
+    if kv_wave or mix_wave:
+        c += [
+            "  v_readfirstlane_b32 s26, v0",
+            "  s_lshr_b32 s26, s26, 6",
+            f"  s_cmp_{'ge' if mix_wave else 'eq'}_u32 s26, 4",
+            f"  s_cbranch_scc1 {'.Lkvwave' if kv_wave else '.Lmxwave'}",
+        ]
+    _header(c, timeline)
+    r = _emit(c, cfg, mode, knock, timeline, {})
+    _footer(c, timeline, r["V_E"])
+    ka, block, name, lds, sgprs = KA, 256, cfg.name, r["lds"], 72
+    if kv_wave:
+        c.append(".Lkvwave:")
+        rstd = kv_wave == "rstd"
+        ka = KA_KVR if rstd else KA_KV
+        if kv_bar:
+            assert mode == "k" and cfg.S == 1 and not timeline, (
+                "barrier count is mode k S = 1's"
+            )
+            c.append(f"  s_load_dword s53, s[0:1], {KA.off['m']:#x}")
+        c += qkv_norm.source(
+            kv_only=True,
+            ka_base=ka.off["kv_qr_kv"],
+            rstd=rstd,
+            bar_m="s53" if kv_bar else "",
+        )
+        block, name = (
+            320,
+            cfg.name + ("_kvr" if rstd else "_kv") + ("b" if kv_bar else ""),
+        )
+        assert max(r["vgprs"], 96) + r["agprs"] <= 256, "5 waves need 2 per SIMD"
+    if mix_wave:
+        c.append(".Lmxwave:")
+        mk = mix_wave if isinstance(mix_wave, str) else ""
+        assert not mix_bar or (mode == "k" and cfg.S > 1 and not timeline), (
+            "barrier count is mode k split-K's"
+        )
+        c += [
+            f"  s_load_dword s24, s[0:1], {KA.off['m']:#x}",
+            "  s_sub_u32 s26, s26, 4",
+            f"  s_lshl_b32 s25, s26, {ffn_seam.MIX_LDS.bit_length() - 1}",
+            f"  s_mul_i32 s26, s26, {cfg.grid}",
+            "  s_add_u32 s26, s26, s2",
+        ]
+        c += ffn_seam.mix_wave(
+            KA_MX.off["mx_partial"],
+            cfg.grid * mix_waves,
+            lds,
+            knock=mk,
+            first="s26",
+            slot="s25",
+            bar_m="s24" if mix_bar else "",
+        )
+        ka, block, name = KA_MX, 64 * (4 + mix_waves), cfg.name + "_mx" + mk
+        # every wave of a CTA has its own LDS slot (MIX_LDS each)
+        lds, sgprs = lds + ffn_seam.MIX_LDS * mix_waves, 102
+        assert mix_waves <= 4 and max(r["vgprs"], 136) + r["agprs"] <= 256, (
+            "the extra waves need 2 per SIMD"
+        )
+    vgprs, agprs = (
+        max(r["vgprs"], 136 if mix_wave else 96 if kv_wave else 0),
+        r["agprs"],
+    )
+    if extra:
+        cfg2, mode2 = extra
+        ka = KArgs(*ka.args, *[("x2_" + n, "ptr") for n in X2])
+        c += [
+            ".Lx2:",
+            "  v_readfirstlane_b32 s26, v0",
+            "  s_lshr_b32 s26, s26, 6",
+            "  s_cmp_ge_u32 s26, 4",
+            "  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lx2_end",
+            f"  s_sub_u32 s2, s2, {cfg.grid}",
+        ]
+        _header(c, False)
+        c.append(
+            "  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)"
+        )  # (scalar loads may land out of order: no overlap)
+        for i, sreg in enumerate((4, 12, 16)):  # w ws | out outs | part cnt
+            c.append(
+                f"  s_load_dwordx4 s[{sreg}:{sreg + 3}], s[0:1], {ka.off['x2_' + X2[2 * i]]:#x}"
+            )
+        c.append(f"  s_load_dwordx2 s[20:21], s[0:1], {ka.off['x2_cs']:#x}")
+        r2 = _emit(
+            c, cfg2, mode2, knock, False, dict(pf="x2", exit=".Lx2_end", end=".Lx2_end")
+        )
+        c += [".Lx2_end:", "  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)", "  s_endpgm"]
+        vgprs, agprs, lds = (
+            max(vgprs, r2["vgprs"]),
+            max(agprs, r2["agprs"]),
+            max(lds, r2["lds"]),
+        )
+        name += "_x2" + cfg2.name.removeprefix("gemv") + "_" + mode2
+        if kv_wave:
+            assert max(vgprs, 96) + agprs <= 256, "5 waves need 2 per SIMD"
+    src = kernel_source(
+        name, c, ka, lds=lds, vgprs=vgprs, agprs=agprs, sgprs=sgprs, block=block
+    )
+    return dict(
+        name=name,
+        src=src,
+        ka=ka,
+        block=block,
+        grid=cfg.grid + (extra[0].grid if extra else 0),
+    )
+
+
+X2 = ("w", "ws", "out", "outs", "part", "cnt", "cs")  # source(extra=)'s own pointers
+
+
+# wo_b unsplit (160 CTAs of 32 rows over all K, mode "k" only): no split-K
+# rendezvous, 3–3.6 µs faster than WO_B cold at M 64–256
+WO_B1 = Cfg("gemv_wo_b1", N=5120, K=2048, R=32, KS=2048)
+# wqkv in 224 CTAs of 16 rows × half K (mode "k" only): 1.1–1.3 µs faster than WQKV cold at M 64–256
+WQKV16 = Cfg("gemv_wqkv16", N=1792, K=5120, R=16, KS=2560)
+# the same with epilogue "qn" (wq_b folds q_norm)
+WQKV16N = Cfg("gemv_wqkv16n", N=1792, K=5120, R=16, KS=2560, epi="qn")
+# 32-row tiles (as fast as WQKV16 cold at M 64–256) with epilogue "qn2": q → wq_b's MXFP8 x directly
+WQKV32N = Cfg("gemv_wqkv32n", N=1792, K=5120, R=32, KS=1280, epi="qn2")
+
+# the indexer's wq_b on index layers: qr's MXFP8 (wq_b's x) → bf16 [M, 32 × 128];
+# 256 CTAs of 16 rows: cold 4.4 / 5.8 / 7.2 µs at M 64 / 128 / 256 (k, k, t) vs 4.8 / 6.3 / 7.9 with 32 rows
+IDX_WQ_B = Cfg("gemv_idx_wq_b", N=4096, K=1280, R=16, KS=1280)
+# + the indexer q's RoPE and MXFP4 in the epilogue: out = codes [M, 32, 64], outs = scales [M, 32, 4]
+IDX_WQ_BQ = Cfg("gemv_idx_wq_bq", N=4096, K=1280, R=32, KS=1280, epi="idxq")
+
+# the K1 chain's choice (k1_runner.py)
+K1 = {"wqkv": WQKV16, "wq_b": WQ_B, "wo_a": WO_A, "wo_b": WO_B1}

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# mypy: ignore-errors
+# ruff: noqa: E501  (one asm instruction or template line per source line)
+"""Group-table work decode shared by the MoE stage kernels.
+
+The prep (moe_prep.py, or the host in tests) writes a compact group table:
+int32 [NG, 20] = e, 0, 0, 0, picks[16] (p = token*6 + k, -1 = none), one
+record (80 B) per 16-pick group, expert-major, and counts[0] = NG. A stage
+kernel with UPG units per group (18 row blocks for stage 1, 20 chunks for
+stage 2) decodes unit u as group u // UPG, sub-index u % UPG. The grid is
+fixed at `grid` CTAs (a power of two, default GRID). split "ceil" (default):
+CTA b takes units [b*per, b*per+per), per = ceil(n/grid), so up to ~10% of the
+CTAs idle at the tail; "even": [b*n/grid, (b+1)*n/grid) (floored). Measured
+on layer 3: "even" is 0-3% slower at every M
+(memory-bound: idle CTAs cost nothing, and more CTAs straddle groups).
+"table": [counts[4 + b], counts[5 + b]), written by moe_prep source(dsplit=True)
+(cost-balanced; stage 2 only, UPG 20).
+"rr" (K2 v2b): chunk-major round robin. Unit u = c * NG + g (c = sub-index, g =
+group), CTA b takes u = b, b + grid, ... so the grid finishes chunk c before
+chunk c + 1 (roughly). The whole table goes to LDS (g0 = 0); s93 = NG; decode
+with decode_rr.
+
+SGPRs used: s18 = n units, s19 = scratch, s50 = u_end, s52 = u_begin, s90 = g0
+(first group of this CTA, its record at LDS 0), s91 = /UPG magic;
+scratch s76..s81, s92.
+"""
+
+GRID = 256
+REC = 80
+MAGIC = {
+    18: (0xE38E38E4, 4),
+    20: (0xCCCCCCCD, 4),
+}  # x / d = mulhi(x, m) >> sh (x < 2^20)
+
+
+def range_and_copy(
+    UPG: int,
+    counts: int,
+    groups: int,
+    tv: list[int],
+    end_label: str,
+    grid: int = GRID,
+    split: str = "ceil",
+    counts_vec: bool = False,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Counts / groups: SGPR pairs (first index) holding the pointers.
+    counts_vec: read counts with a vector sc1 load (for the K2 kernel, where
+    the table is written earlier in the same launch, possibly by another XCD,
+    and this XCD's L2 may still hold the previous launch's line).
+    split "table" needs a third temp VGPR tv[2]."""
+    m, sh = MAGIC[UPG]
+    lg = grid.bit_length() - 1
+    assert grid == 1 << lg
+    # No glc: a glc scalar load here made the stage kernels 35-55% slower
+    # (measured; cause not isolated). Plain s_load is coherent
+    # with the previous kernel's stores (dispatch acquire).
+    load = (
+        [
+            f"  v_mov_b32 v{tv[0]}, 0",
+            f"  global_load_dword v{tv[1]}, v{tv[0]}, s[{counts}:{counts + 1}] sc1",
+            "  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)",
+            f"  v_readfirstlane_b32 s18, v{tv[1]}",
+        ]
+        if counts_vec
+        else [f"  s_load_dword s18, s[{counts}:{counts + 1}], 0x0"]
+    )
+    if split == "rr":
+        rng = [
+            "  s_mov_b32 s93, s18",
+            f"  s_mul_i32 s18, s18, {UPG}",
+            "  s_mov_b32 s52, s2",
+            "  s_mov_b32 s50, s18",
+        ]
+    elif split == "table":
+        assert UPG == 20 and len(tv) > 2
+        rng = (
+            [
+                "  s_lshl_b32 s80, s2, 2",
+                f"  v_mov_b32 v{tv[0]}, s80",  # s19 may be counts' high dword
+                f"  global_load_dword v{tv[1]}, v{tv[0]}, s[{counts}:{counts + 1}] offset:16 sc1",
+                f"  global_load_dword v{tv[2]}, v{tv[0]}, s[{counts}:{counts + 1}] offset:20 sc1",
+                "  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)",
+                f"  v_readfirstlane_b32 s52, v{tv[1]}",
+                f"  v_readfirstlane_b32 s50, v{tv[2]}",
+            ]
+            if counts_vec
+            else [
+                "  s_lshl_b32 s80, s2, 2",
+                "  s_add_u32 s80, s80, 16",
+                f"  s_load_dwordx2 s[76:77], s[{counts}:{counts + 1}], s80",
+                "  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)",
+                "  s_mov_b32 s52, s76",
+                "  s_mov_b32 s50, s77",
+            ]
+        )
+        load = []
+    else:
+        rng = [
+            f"  s_mul_i32 s18, s18, {UPG}",  # units
+            *(
+                [
+                    "  s_mul_i32 s52, s2, s18",
+                    f"  s_lshr_b32 s52, s52, {lg}",  # u_begin = b * n / grid
+                    "  s_add_u32 s19, s2, 1",
+                    "  s_mul_i32 s50, s19, s18",
+                    f"  s_lshr_b32 s50, s50, {lg}",
+                ]  # u_end = (b + 1) * n / grid
+                if split == "even"
+                else [
+                    f"  s_add_u32 s19, s18, {grid - 1}",
+                    f"  s_lshr_b32 s19, s19, {lg}",  # per = ceil(n / grid)
+                    "  s_mul_i32 s52, s2, s19",
+                    "  s_add_u32 s50, s52, s19",
+                    "  s_min_u32 s50, s50, s18",
+                ]
+            ),
+        ]
+    o = [
+        *load,
+        f"  s_mov_b32 s91, {m:#x}",
+        "  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)",
+        *rng,
+        "  s_cmp_ge_u32 s52, s50",
+        f"  s_cbranch_scc1 {end_label}",
+        *(
+            ["  s_mov_b32 s90, 0", "  s_mov_b32 s92, s93"]
+            if split == "rr"
+            else [
+                "  s_mul_hi_u32 s90, s52, s91",
+                f"  s_lshr_b32 s90, s90, {sh}",  # g0
+                "  s_sub_u32 s92, s50, 1",
+                "  s_mul_hi_u32 s92, s92, s91",
+                f"  s_lshr_b32 s92, s92, {sh}",  # g1
+                "  s_sub_u32 s92, s92, s90",
+                "  s_add_u32 s92, s92, 1",
+            ]
+        ),
+        f"  s_mul_i32 s77, s92, {REC}",  # bytes to copy
+        f"  s_mul_i32 s76, s90, {REC}",
+        f"  s_add_u32 s78, s{groups}, s76",
+        f"  s_addc_u32 s79, s{groups + 1}, 0",
+        f"  v_lshlrev_b32 v{tv[0]}, 2, v0",
+        f"{end_label}_copy:",
+        f"  v_cmp_gt_u32 vcc, s77, v{tv[0]}",
+        "  s_and_saveexec_b64 s[80:81], vcc",
+        f"  s_cbranch_execz {end_label}_copied",
+        f"  global_load_dword v{tv[1]}, v{tv[0]}, s[78:79]",
+        "  s_waitcnt vmcnt(0)",
+        f"  ds_write_b32 v{tv[0]}, v{tv[1]}",
+        f"  v_add_u32 v{tv[0]}, 1024, v{tv[0]}",
+        "  s_mov_b64 exec, s[80:81]",
+        f"  s_branch {end_label}_copy",
+        f"{end_label}_copied:",
+        "  s_mov_b64 exec, -1",
+        "  s_waitcnt lgkmcnt(0)",
+        "  s_barrier",
+    ]
+    return o
+
+
+_rr_n = [0]
+
+
+def decode_rr(u_sgpr: int, g: int, sub: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Split "rr": s{g} = u % NG, s{sub} = u // NG (NG = s93), s76 = LDS offset of the record."""
+    _rr_n[0] += 1
+    t = _rr_n[0]
+    return [
+        f"  s_mov_b32 s{g}, s{u_sgpr}",
+        f"  s_mov_b32 s{sub}, 0",
+        f".Lrr{t}:",
+        f"  s_cmp_lt_u32 s{g}, s93",
+        f"  s_cbranch_scc1 .Lrrd{t}",
+        f"  s_sub_u32 s{g}, s{g}, s93",
+        f"  s_add_u32 s{sub}, s{sub}, 1",
+        f"  s_branch .Lrr{t}",
+        f".Lrrd{t}:",
+        f"  s_mul_i32 s76, s{g}, {REC}",
+    ]
+
+
+def decode(UPG: int, u_sgpr: int, g: int, sub: int) -> list[str]:
+    """s{g} = u // UPG (the gid), s{sub} = u % UPG, s76 = LDS offset of the record."""
+    _, sh = MAGIC[UPG]
+    return [
+        f"  s_mul_hi_u32 s{g}, s{u_sgpr}, s91",
+        f"  s_lshr_b32 s{g}, s{g}, {sh}",
+        f"  s_mul_i32 s{sub}, s{g}, {UPG}",
+        f"  s_sub_u32 s{sub}, s{u_sgpr}, s{sub}",
+        f"  s_sub_u32 s76, s{g}, s90",
+        f"  s_mul_i32 s76, s76, {REC}",
+    ]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# mypy: ignore-errors
+# ruff: noqa: E501  (one asm instruction or template line per source line)
+"""The indexer's MXFP4 logits and its top-512 in one
+launch. Replaces aiter's ``paged_mxfp4_mqa_logits`` (decode, next_n 1) plus
+e1's idx_topk launch:
+
+    logits[row, t] = Σ_h w[row, h] · relu(q[row, h] · k[t]),  t < n = lens[row]
+
+q: 32 heads × 128 dims MXFP4 per row; k: aiter's preshuffled MXFP4 pages
+(``cache_format``: E tokens per page, n_per_tile 32, d_per_tile 16, two scale
+lanes): a page holds E·64 value bytes, then E·4 scale bytes. Group g of 32
+tokens: value chunk c (dims 32c .. 32c + 31) of token τ at 2048 g + 512 c + 16 τ,
+scale s at E·64 + 128 g + 64 (s % 2) + 2 τ + s / 2.
+
+Grid: 8·S·ceil(rows / 8) CTAs of 8 waves, S = 2^slog splits per row. CTA b:
+x = b % 8, j = b / 8, row = x + 8 (j >> slog), split = j % S, so a row's
+splits run on one XCD (the hand-off stays in its L2, as A3's combine). The
+wide split kernel (no hand-off) maps slice-major instead: 8 j + x = S row +
+split, slice s of every row on XCD s % 8. The
+row's G = ceil(n / 32) groups are cut into S slices of ceil(G / S); wave w
+takes the slice's groups w, w + 8, ...
+
+Per group (one wave): 2 dwordx4 + 1 ushort per lane (the B operands and their
+scales come straight from the page: lane l = token l % 32, dims 64 kb +
+32 (l / 32)), two ``v_mfma_scale_f32_32x32x64_f8f6f4`` (A = q: lane l = head
+l % 32), D = 32 heads × 32 tokens; the fold relu → ·w → Σ over the lane's 16
+heads, + the other half-wave's 16 (permlane32 swap), → LDS (S = 1) or the
+global row (S > 1). D groups of loads in flight per wave (a ring), two
+accumulators (the fold of group i − 1 runs behind the MFMAs of group i). The
+K loads are ``nt`` (read once; at M 64 the loop streams 6.1 TB/s, plain 4.7).
+Before the first K load: n / req / valid (SMEM) and the row's K block table
+(→ LDS, one entry per thread) are issued together with q / w.
+
+Then S = 1: the folds wrote the row's logits to LDS; the top-512 (idx_topk's
+code, its loads from LDS) runs in the same CTA. S > 1: the folds store the
+logits straight to the global row (vmcnt is in order for loads and stores
+mixed, so the ring's wait counts just include them); after a barrier wave 0
+takes a ticket, ``global_atomic_inc`` on cnt[row] (one counter per 128 B line:
+same-line atomics serialise) wrapping at S − 1 (graph-replay safe); the last
+arriver runs the top-512 on the row (``nt`` loads: same XCD, so L2 is
+coherent). A ticket per wave costs ~8 µs at M 64 (8× the same-line atomics).
+
+Kernargs: idx_topk's (same offsets; ``logits`` = the global scratch rows for
+S > 1, lstride a multiple of 128 B covering 32 G columns) + KA below. kbt =
+the indexer K block table (row-indexed, ≤ 512 pages per row), page_stride in
+bytes (< 2^32).
+"""
+
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels import idx_topk
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.amd.asm.kernels.kmod import KArgs, kernel_source
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+
+KA = KArgs(
+    *idx_topk.KA.args,
+    ("q", "ptr"),
+    ("qs", "ptr"),
+    ("w", "ptr"),
+    ("kv", "ptr"),
+    ("kbt", "ptr"),
+    ("cnt", "ptr"),
+    ("rows", "u32"),
+    ("kbt_stride", "u32"),
+    ("page_stride", "u32"),
+    ("e_log2", "u32"),
+    ("slog", "u32"),
+)
+KA_DBG = KArgs(*KA.args, ("dbg", "ptr"))
+KA_W, KA_W_DBG = KA, KA_DBG
+KA_S = KArgs(
+    *KA.args, ("bs", "ptr"), ("bs_stride", "u32")
+)  # wide + block scores (the candidate source)
+KA_S_DBG = KArgs(*KA_S.args, ("dbg", "ptr"))
+KA_G = KArgs(
+    *KA.args, ("cand", "ptr"), ("cand_stride", "u32")
+)  # wide + gather (the candidate consumers)
+KA_G_DBG = KArgs(*KA_G.args, ("dbg", "ptr"))
+assert (
+    KA_G.off["cand"] == KA_S.off["bs"]
+    and KA_G.off["cand_stride"] == KA_S.off["bs_stride"]
+)
+NCAND, CBLK = 2048, 8  # gather: candidate blocks per row, positions per block
+assert KA.off["q"] == 0x50 and KA.off["rows"] == 0x80 and KA.off["slog"] == 0x90
+NSTAMP = 32
+T = 512
+
+# VGPRs of the logits phase (v0 = tid stays)
+V_L, V_16L, V_2L, V_4L, V_PG = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
+QA = (8, 12)  # q, K blocks 0 / 1 of the lane's head
+QS = 16  # q scales, byte 0 = block 0, byte 2 = block 1
+W = 20  # 16 weights: acc r ↔ head 8 (r / 4) + 4 (l / 32) + r % 4
+ACC = (36, 52)
+RING = 68  # D slots of 12: 8 value VGPRs, 1 scale
+
+# SGPRs: s[4:23] idx_topk's kernargs, s25 / s26 / s27 n, req, valid word (loaded here for the top-k);
+# s[84:100] ours; s72 row (kept for the top-k)
+S_ROW, S_SPL, S_G, S_GLO, S_GHI, S_W, S_NG, S_I, S_PREV, S_GLW, S_GMASK = (
+    72,
+    73,
+    75,
+    76,
+    77,
+    78,
+    79,
+    80,
+    81,
+    82,
+    83,
+)
+S_N, S_REQ, S_VW = 25, 26, 27
+S_SLOG, S_CNTC = 100, 101
+S_SM1, S_GSH, S_E64, S_NG1, S_LGW = 58, 38, 39, 56, 57
+S_PG0 = 57  # wide: the slice's first page (prologue only; S_LGW later)
+S_NT = 74  # wide: the row's n
+S_NS = 62  # wide: the slice's live count (s62 / 63 only serve the global path)
+S_TAG = 63  # wide: this call's tag << 24 (cnt[row] + 1, mod 256)
+S_SH = 44  # wide, prologue → the loop: the slice's first page is shared (1) or not
+S_CAPS = 77  # wide, in the merge: S · CAPS slots (S_GHI is free by then)
+S_REQ2, S_VW2 = (
+    80,
+    81,
+)  # wide: req / valid word kept for the merge (S_I / S_PREV are free by then)
+
+
+def plan(width: int, m: int, slog: int | None = None):
+    """(nl, lg_cap, lds_s1, slog) for rows of ≤ width columns at m rows: S = 4 / 2 / 1 at m ≤ 64 / ≤ 128 / more
+    (S ≥ 2 if the row can't stay in LDS, more if a wave's page ids would not fit one VGPR); lg_cap depends on the
+    width only, so one kernel serves every m."""
+    nl = -(-width // 2048)
+    G = -(-width // 32)
+    lds_s1 = nl <= 5  # the top-k's LDS reads must sit below 64 KB
+    if slog is None:
+        slog = 2 if m <= 64 else 1 if m <= 128 else 0
+    if not lds_s1:
+        slog = max(slog, 1)
+    while cdiv(cdiv(G, 1 << slog), 8) > 64:
+        slog += 1
+    lg_cap = 64 * nl if lds_s1 else cdiv(cdiv(G, 2), 16) * 16
+    assert -(-G // (1 << slog)) <= lg_cap
+    return nl, lg_cap, lds_s1, slog
+
+
+CAPS = 640  # wide: candidate slots per slice (≥ 512: the exact fallback's)
+
+
+CMAX = 4096  # wide: the compacted merge's room (candidates with key ≥ τ_row)
+
+
+def row_slots(nlf: int, slog: int) -> int:
+    """8 B slots per candidates row: S segments of CAPS, then S τ slots, ≥ the full merge's 2048 nlf loads."""
+    S = 1 << slog
+    return max(2048 * nlf, -(-(S * CAPS + S) // 16) * 16)
+
+
+SLOG_MAX = 5  # wide: ≤ 32 CTAs per row (the merge's τ slots: one per lane)
+
+
+def plan_wide(width: int, m: int, slog: int | None = None, cap: int = 512):
+    """(nl, lg_cap, nlf, slog) for the wide-row kernel: S = 2^slog CTAs per row, each slice ≤ cap groups (its
+    logits in LDS, ≤ 32 cap columns), S ≥ 512 / m CTAs per row at small m (≤ 2^SLOG_MAX); nl = the per-slice
+    top-k's loads, nlf = the merge's (S · CAPS candidates). A kernel built for m = 256 (the fewest, widest
+    slices) serves every m (its slices only get shorter)."""
+    G = -(-width // 32)
+    if slog is None:
+        slog = min(SLOG_MAX, max(0, (-(-512 // m) - 1).bit_length()))
+    while -(-G // (1 << slog)) > cap:
+        slog += 1
+    assert slog <= SLOG_MAX, (width, slog)
+    per = -(-G // (1 << slog))
+    nl = -(-per // 64)
+    lg_cap = 64 * nl
+    nlf = -(-(1 << slog) * CAPS // 2048)
+    return nl, lg_cap, nlf, slog
+
+
+def plan_gather(m: int, slog: int | None = None):
+    """(nl, lg_cap, nlf, slog) for the gather mode (the candidate consumers: ≤ NCAND · CBLK live columns per
+    row): S = 4 CTAs per row at m ≤ 64, else 2 (the best at 200k with plain K loads)."""
+    G = NCAND * CBLK // 32
+    if slog is None:
+        slog = 2 if m <= 64 else 1
+    per = -(-G // (1 << slog))
+    nl = -(-per // 64)
+    return nl, 64 * nl, -(-(1 << slog) * CAPS // 2048), slog
+
+
+def source(
+    nl: int = 5,
+    lg_cap: int = 320,
+    depth: int = 4,
+    lds_s1: bool = True,
+    bt_max: int = 1024,
+    name: str | None = None,
+    stamps: bool = False,
+    kflag: str = "nt",
+    ticket: str = "cta",
+    aflag: str = "sc0",
+    cshift: int = 7,
+    wide: bool = False,
+    nlf: int = 2,
+    wdbg: int = 0,
+    st_flag: str = "",
+    kshared: str | None = None,
+    split: bool = False,
+    dup: int = 1,
+    probe: str = "",
+    bsc: bool = False,
+    gather: bool = False,
+):
+    """nl: the top-k's loads per thread (width ≤ 2048 nl); lg_cap: groups per CTA slice (≥ ceil(G / S));
+    lds_s1: S = 1 allowed (the row's logits stay in LDS; needs lg_cap·128 ≥ 8192 nl); stamps: wave 0 writes
+    s_memtime at the phase boundaries to dbg[cta][0..7] (u64); kflag: cache flag of the K loads (e.g. "nt");
+    ticket (S > 1): "cta" (one atomic per CTA after a barrier) or "wave" (one
+    per wave, the CTA learns through LDS); aflag: the ticket atomic's flags (sc0 = return the old value, at L2:
+    a row's CTAs share an XCD; "sc0 sc1" = system scope); cshift: cnt[row] sits at byte row << cshift (7: one
+    counter per 128 B line, as same-line atomics serialise).
+    wide: rows wider than one CTA's top-k (module doc); every slice's logits stay in LDS (lg_cap groups),
+    nl = the slice top-k's loads per thread, nlf = the merge's (≥ S · CAPS / 2048), bt_max ≥ the merge's
+    block-table entries per row; kshared: None = per slice, plain K loads when its first page is also row ^ 1's
+    or row ^ 2's (a shared prefix: the page stays in L2 / MALL for them), else kflag; or a fixed flag ("none" =
+    plain); split: no merge here (every CTA leaves after its candidates; merge_source's kernel follows);
+    split maps CTAs slice-major (module doc; rows that share pages, spec decode's draft rows or a shared prefix,
+    read each slice on one XCD; the row-major map was ~1-3 µs faster at M ≤ 128 with distinct contexts, as the
+    merge's CTA for row r then ran on the XCD that wrote its slots, and up to 2x slower otherwise). dup / probe:
+    timing probes only (wrong results): dup 2 = every group's MFMAs + fold twice on the same loads (a wave serving
+    two rows); probe "nomfma" / "nofold" / "nohist" leaves that part of the loop out.
+    bsc (wide split): also the block scores of the candidate source (vLLM's ``block_scores``): the max over
+    every 8 positions (-inf past n), the row's newest block +inf, to bs + row · bs_stride + 4 b (fp32). After
+    the loop, from the slice's logits in LDS (no stores in the loop: the ring's in-order vmcnt waits would
+    wait for them); they drain while the filter runs.
+    gather (wide split, the candidate consumers): the row's columns are its candidate blocks
